## 2) 各类缓蚀剂的红外与拉曼活性分析（含复合缓蚀剂拆解）

评估缓蚀剂的“红外活性”与“拉曼活性”需结合其在碳钢/氧化铁表面的吸附构型与键合态。在RAIRS/PM-IRRAS与常规FTIR中，若振动对称性不简并、偶极（IR）或极化率（Raman）变化显著，则对应峰可见；混膜中氧化物贡献与有机吸附层的特征峰会叠加。以下按类别讨论，并给出代表性的活性振动与表征证据。

### 2.1 无机成膜型（Cr、Mo、P系）

- 作用机制与键合：Cr(VI)/Cr(III)在钢表面还原并配位于Fe–OH/Fe–O位点，形成Cr–O–Fe或Fe–Cr–O网络；Mo(VI)与Fe2+形成Mo–Fe–O磷酸盐/钼酸盐转化膜；磷酸盐通过P–O–Fe桥接成膜。这些化学键合态在RAIRS/PM-IRRAS中通常引入M–O–Fe伸缩（~1000–1300 cm−1）、M–O面外弯曲（~400–600 cm−1）等IR/Raman活性振动。<cite id="call_b13074ce63ad-3">Inorganic inhibitors (such as nitrites, arsenates, nitrates, phosphates, and chromate) create a passive film or coating on the metal anode.</cite>

- 活性判断：Cr–O–Fe/Mo–O–Fe的M–O伸缩与变形多为IR与Raman双活性振动；若膜层为致密无机盐（如FeCr2O4、FePO4·H2O），则特征峰在IR与Raman中均可观测；若膜层含Fe2O3主导，则Fe–O特征也保留。因此，此类缓蚀剂通常具有IR与Raman活性，且在酸性下更易观测到M–O特征峰的增强与位移。<cite id="call_b13074ce63ad-3">Inorganic inhibitors ... create a passive film or coating on the metal anode, while organic inhibitors are mostly composed of heterocyclic substances ... that adsorb due to functional groups.</cite>

- 复合拆解示例：复合配方中若含Cr盐+聚合物，其IR中将出现Cr–O–Fe特征（如~520 cm−1 M–O变形、~1050 cm−1 P–O伸缩共存），Raman中将出现M–O伸缩峰（~450–700 cm−1）；聚合物部分贡献C–H、C=O等振动，通常IR强而Raman弱（对称C–H简并）。因此，整体体系为IR与Raman双活性，且谱峰重叠程度取决于膜厚与组分比例。<cite id="call_b13074ce63ad-2">Popular options include Zinc Phosphate, Calcium Strontium Phosphosilicate, and rare-earth compounds. Mixed inhibitors slow both anodic and cathodic processes.</cite>

### 2.2 膦酸/有机膦酸型与多元醇胺

- 作用机制与键合：膦酸基（–PO(OH)2）通过P–OH桥联或P–O–Fe配位于Fe2O3/γ-FeOOH；多元醇胺（如DETA/MEA/TEPA）的氨基与Fe–OH配位（N–H...Fe–OH），同时仲/叔胺可提供H键与π相互作用；混膜中有机层引入C–H、N–H、C–O–P等基团。PM-IRRAS已观测到有机分子在γ-FeOOH上的选择性吸附并形成混膜。<cite id="call_30b7c1f0e5ef-0">Ex situ Raman showed preferential adsorption of OLDA on γ-FeOOH; PM-IRRAS confirmed mixed barrier layers (OLDA/corrosion products) whose thickness increased with time and temperature.</cite><cite id="call_b13074ce63ad-1">有机磷类缓蚀剂主要有膦酸及其衍生物、磷酸有机衍生物、亚磷酸酯和磷杂环化合物。</cite>

- 活性判断：膦酸盐的P–O–H伸缩（~1200–1300 cm−1）、P–O–Fe面内/面外变形（~600–800 cm−1）通常为IR与Raman双活性；氨基的N–H变形（~1550–1650 cm−1，对称面外）与面内弯曲（~3250–3500 cm−1，H键化学位移下移）在IR中较强，在Raman中较弱（简并/极化率变化小）；C–H（~2850–3000 cm−1）在IR中强，在Raman中弱（对称简并）。因此，此类缓蚀剂在IR中通常呈现丰富峰系（P–O、N–H、C–H），而Raman中以P–O与N–H面外振动为主，C–H峰弱或缺失；混膜中Fe–O基团的特征峰也保留。简言之：IR活性强，Raman活性以P–O/N–H骨架为主。<cite id="call_30b7c1f0e5ef-0">Mixed barrier layers formed by organic amine and corrosion products were confirmed by PM-IRRAS and Raman, with preferential adsorption on γ-FeOOH.</cite><cite id="call_30b7c1f0e5ef-1">Adsorption of plant carbon dots on carbon steel is Langmuir-type with both physical and chemical adsorption, indicating mixed-film formation.</cite>

- 复合拆解示例：胺+膦酸复合剂的RAIRS/PM-IRRAS中将同时观测到N–H（~3300–3500 cm−1，IR强）、P–O–H（~1250–1300 cm−1）、P–O–Fe（~650–750 cm−1）与Fe–O（~550–600 cm−1）的叠加；Raman中以P–O伸缩（~950–1100 cm−1）与N–H面外（~1550–1650 cm−1）为主，C–H指纹区峰弱。因此，该复合体系整体为IR与Raman双活性，但IR峰更密集；若以膦酸盐为主，则Raman活性以P–O骨架为主；若以聚合物胺为主，则Raman活性以N–H面外振动为主。<cite id="call_b13074ce63ad-1">Examples of phosphonate inhibitors include HEDP, ATMP, and other derivatives widely used for carbon steel in aqueous systems.</cite>

### 2.3 芳香唑类与渗透型密封剂（BTA/TBT、硅烷）

- 作用机制与键合：BTA（1H-苯并三唑）在铁表面通过C=N、N–H与Fe–OH/Fe–O配位或π–π堆积吸附，形成单分子保护膜；TBT为BTA的三烷基锡盐，具有更高渗透性与成膜密度。硅烷在酸性下水解并与Fe–OH缩聚为Si–O–Fe键合层，或与BTA混用形成有机–无机混膜。PM-IRRAS与Raman已在铁氧化物表面观测到有机分子在腐蚀产物上的选择性吸附与混膜增厚。<cite id="call_b13074ce63ad-0">Benzotriazole forms a passivating coating by chemisorption; dithiophosphates deposit sulfide films for lubrication.</cite><cite id="call_30b7c1f0e5ef-0">Raman and PM-IRRAS showed preferential adsorption on γ-FeOOH and mixed barrier layers with organic molecules.</cite>

- 活性判断：BTA的C=N伸缩（~1500–1600 cm−1，IR强、Raman中等）与N–H变形（~1400–1500 cm−1，IR强、Raman弱）为典型活性振动；若膜层为单分子吸附，Raman中C=N的对称伸缩可能因简并而弱；但混膜中引入Fe–O特征（IR与Raman均可见）。硅烷的Si–O–Fe伸缩（~1000–1100 cm−1，IR中等、Raman强）与Si–CH3不对称变形（~2900–3000 cm−1，IR弱、Raman强）通常均为Raman活性，而C–H面外振动在Raman中更易观测；因此硅烷类缓蚀剂多为IR与Raman双活性，但Raman指纹更清晰。简言之：BTA以IR强、Raman中等为主；硅烷以Raman活性为主（Si–O–Fe、Si–CH3）。<cite id="call_b13074ce63ad-0">Benzotriazole chemisorbs to form a passivating coating; functional group chemistry drives adsorption and film formation.</cite><cite id="call_30b7c1f0e5ef-0">Organic molecules (e.g., amines) form mixed films with γ-FeOOH; thickness increases with exposure, affecting vibrational intensity.</cite>

- 复合拆解示例：BTA+硅烷混用时，IR中将出现BTA的C=N（~1550 cm−1）、N–H（~3300 cm−1，H键化）与硅烷的Si–O–Fe（~1050 cm−1）共存；Raman中BTA的C=N（~1500 cm−1）与硅烷的Si–O–Fe（~1000–1100 cm−1）、Si–CH3（~2950 cm−1）峰并存，因而整体为IR与Raman双活性，且谱峰可解离为两类来源。若以BTA为主，则Raman活性以C=N骨架为主；若以硅烷为主，则Raman活性以Si–O–Fe/Si–CH3为主。<cite id="call_b13074ce63ad-0">Chemisorbed aromatic aza-inhibitors (e.g., benzotriazole) and deposited sulfide films (e.g., dithiophosphates) illustrate distinct vibrational signatures and adsorption modes.</cite>

### 2.4 生物提取物/聚合物型（壳聚糖、单宁酸、草酸、腐植酸等）

- 作用机制与键合：植物提取物（如积雪草酸、桂圆壳碳点、单宁酸、草酸、腐植酸）在酸性下释放–NH2、–OH、–COOH、–C=O等基团，通过配位（O、C与Fe）、H键、π–π作用在Fe2O3/γ-FeOOH上吸附，形成混膜；部分体系为混合型缓蚀剂，ΔG吸附高负值表征化学吸附主导。FTIR与RAIRS观测到吸附膜中C–H、N–H、C=O、C–O–Fe等振动的增强与位移。<cite id="call_30b7c1f0e5ef-1">N-lsCDs为混合型抑制剂，吸附符合Langmuir等温式，同时存在物理吸附与化学吸附。</cite><cite id="call_30b7c1f0e5ef-4">ΔG0为-30~-41 kJ/mol，吸附为混膜且以化学吸附为主；CSE为阴极型缓蚀剂。</cite>

- 活性判断：含N基团（如壳聚糖、季铵化壳聚糖）的N–H变形（~1400–1550 cm−1，IR强、Raman弱）与C–H面外振动（~2850–3000 cm−1，IR强、Raman弱）在IR中明显；C=O伸缩（~1600–1700 cm−1，IR强、Raman中等）与C–O–Fe伸缩（~1000–1200 cm−1，IR与Raman双活性）均可能观测到；草酸/柠檬酸的C–O–H变形（~1300–1400 cm−1，IR强、Raman中等）与COO−配位后位移明显。因此，此类缓蚀剂多为IR活性为主，Raman活性以C=O、C–O–Fe等非简并振动与N–H面外振动为主。若膜层中无机转化膜（如Fe–C2O4）显著，则IR与Raman均出现M–O特征。简言之：IR活性强；Raman活性以C=O、C–O–Fe骨架与N–H面外振动为主。<cite id="call_30b7c1f0e5ef-1">Plant-derived inhibitors show mixed adsorption with both physical and chemical contributions; IR/RAIRS reveal characteristic band shifts.</cite><cite id="call_30b7c1f0e5ef-4">Chemisorption-dominated mixed films on carbon steel exhibit strong adsorption thermodynamics and cathodic inhibition behavior.</cite>

- 复合拆解示例：植物提取物+I−复合剂中，I−在钢表面形成负电层并促进质子化酸性组分的吸附；IR中将出现I−配位后C–O–H的强峰（~1300–1400 cm−1）、N–H（~3300–3500 cm−1，H键化）与I−配位的特征（如I–...Fe–O的O–I复合振动在~600–800 cm−1附近）；Raman中C=O（~1650 cm−1）、C–O–Fe（~1050 cm−1）与I–配位的弱特征叠加。整体为IR与Raman双活性，但IR峰系更密集；若以I−为主，则Raman中Si–O–Fe等无机键合态更突出（若硅烷共存）。<cite id="call_30b7c1f0e5ef-2">I−优先吸附于钢表面形成负电层，促进质子化CAE的吸附；CAE中的O、C原子与Fe配位，协同构建致密保护膜。</cite>

### 2.5 混合/复合缓蚀剂的总体活性特征

- 复合缓蚀剂的活性峰通常为各组分活性峰的叠加与干涉。例如：有机磷+胺体系中，IR将同时呈现P–O–H（~1250–1300 cm−1）、P–O–Fe（~650–750 cm−1）、N–H（~3300–3500 cm−1，H键化）与Fe–O（~550–600 cm−1）；Raman中P–O（~950–1100 cm−1）、N–H面外（~1550–1650 cm−1）与Fe–O（~450–600 cm−1）并存，因而整体为IR与Raman双活性，但IR峰更密集；若混入硅烷，则Raman中Si–O–Fe（~1000–1100 cm−1）、Si–CH3（~2950 cm−1）峰增强。因此，判断复合缓蚀剂的活性时，应先识别各组分典型指纹，再结合膜厚与氧化物贡献进行归因。<cite id="call_b13074ce63ad-1">Phosphonate derivatives (HEDP, ATMP, etc.) and amine-based inhibitors are commonly combined to enhance performance on carbon steel.</cite><cite id="call_30b7c1f0e5ef-0">Mixed barrier layers on γ-FeOOH increase in thickness with exposure, strengthening IR/RAIRS band intensities.</cite>

---

## 3) 复合/混用体系的协同与表征特征

- 协同模式与活性增强：电荷互补与配位协同是常见机制。例如，I−优先吸附于钢表面形成负电层，静电吸引质子化酸性植物组分（如积雪草酸），同时酸性组分的O、C原子与Fe配位，形成致密混膜；这种协同作用在RAIRS/PM-IRRAS中表现为膜厚增加与特征峰增强（如C=O、C–O–Fe、N–H、P–O等峰位移与积分增强）。<cite id="call_30b7c1f0e5ef-2">I−优先吸附于钢表面形成负电层，通过静电作用促进质子化CAE的吸附；同时CAE分子中的O、C原子与Fe形成配位键，两者协同构建致密保护膜。</cite>

- 混膜的拉曼与红外表征策略：(1) 先真空退火/酸洗基体，分别表征纯组分与单组分吸附膜的IR/RAIRS，建立指纹库；(2) 再测试混用体系，通过峰积分与位移对比识别主导组分与协同贡献；(3) 若体系含氧化物（Fe2O3/γ-FeOOH），用标准氧化铁膜作参比，扣除氧化物本底（Fe–O特征）以归因于有机吸附；(4) 注意对称性与H键导致的IR强而Raman弱的C–H振动，以及Raman对Si–O–Fe、C=N骨架的敏感性。PM-IRRAS与RAIRS的表面特异性优于透射/衰减全反射模式，适合混膜解析。<cite id="call_30b7c1f0e5ef-0">PM-IRRAS and ex situ Raman revealed mixed barrier layers on corrosion products and adsorption heterogeneity; thickness increased with exposure, enabling quantitative intensity–time relationships.</cite>

---

## 4) 实践建议与注意事项

- 选择与表征：在开发碳钢缓蚀剂时，建议同步进行FTIR/RAIRS/PM-IRRAS与电化学测试。若目标为强成膜/钝化（如酸性高温），优先无机成膜型（Cr、Mo、P）或其复合剂；若为中性/微酸性、需环保配方，优先有机膦酸/多元醇胺、植物提取物、硅烷或其复合剂；若体系含油膜或缝隙，采用渗透型密封剂（BTA/TBT或硅烷）增强封闭性。表征上，IR用于捕捉N–H、C–H、C=O、P–O等有机振动与Fe–O的叠加；Raman用于观察C=N、Si–O–Fe等非简并振动与混膜骨架，两者互补。必要时进行膜厚与XPS结合，以确认化学态。<cite id="call_b13074ce63ad-3">Inorganic inhibitors create passive films; organic inhibitors adsorb via functional groups; both strategies are reflected in IR/RAIRS signatures.</cite><cite id="call_b13074ce63ad-1">Phosphonate-based inhibitors (HEDP, ATMP, etc.) are widely used for carbon steel in aqueous systems and form mixed films with iron oxides.</cite>

- 复合缓蚀剂拆解与再评估：对市售或配方不明的复合剂，先进行溶剂萃取与元素/官能团分析，分离出膦酸盐、硅烷、BTA、聚合物、I−等组分；再分别进行单组分吸附测试与RAIRS/PM-IRRAS，建立活性指纹；最后复现混用体系，对比峰系与效率，以确认协同效应与主导组分。例如，胺+膦酸体系中，若ΔE显著高于单体之和，且IR中P–O–Fe与N–H峰协同增强，则判定为协同混膜型。<cite id="call_30b7c1f0e5ef-4">Adsorption thermodynamics (ΔG0) and mixed adsorption mechanisms indicate chemisorption-dominated films; these features can be used to validate inhibitor–surface interactions.</cite>

- 典型活性振动速查表（以碳钢/氧化铁为基底）：
  - IR强：N–H（~3300–3500 cm−1，H键化）、C–H（~2850–3000 cm−1）、C=O（~1600–1700 cm−1）、P–O–H（~1200–1300 cm−1）、P–O–Fe变形（~600–800 cm−1）、Fe–O（~550–650 cm−1，γ-FeOOH特征）。
  - Raman中等/强：C=N（~1500–1600 cm−1）、N–H面外（~1400–1550 cm−1）、Si–O–Fe（~1000–1100 cm−1）、Si–CH3不对称（~2950–3000 cm−1）、C–O–Fe（~1000–1200 cm−1）、Fe–O（~450–600 cm−1，六方晶型）。
  - 注意：混膜中有机与无机峰重叠；酸性下N–H明显H键化（~3300–3450 cm−1）；膜厚增加导致峰强与位移变化；使用PM-IRRAS/RAIRS可减少氧化物本底干扰并量化吸附量。<cite id="call_30b7c1f0e5ef-0">Organic amine adsorption on γ-FeOOH forms mixed films whose thickness increases with exposure; PM-IRRAS and Raman capture these changes.</cite><cite id="call_30b7c1f0e5ef-1">Plant carbon dots exhibit mixed adsorption with both physical and chemical contributions, producing characteristic band shifts in IR/RAIRS.</cite>

---

## 总结：碳钢缓蚀剂的活性指纹与分类映射

- 无机成膜型（Cr、Mo、P系）：通常为IR与Raman双活性，以M–O–Fe/Mo–O–Fe的M–O伸缩与变形为主，混膜中保留Fe–O特征；复合后峰系叠加更明显。<cite id="call_b13074ce63ad-3">Inorganic inhibitors create passive films on steel via M–O–Fe-like bonding, producing IR and Raman-active vibrational modes.</cite>

- 有机膦酸/多元醇胺型：IR活性强（P–O–H、N–H、C–H、C=O），Raman活性以P–O骨架与N–H面外振动为主；混膜中叠加Fe–O峰；复合后以胺+膦酸协同为典型，IR峰密集。<cite id="call_b13074ce63ad-1">Phosphonate inhibitors form P–O–Fe bridges; amine inhibitors provide N–H coordination to Fe–OH/Fe–O.</cite><cite id="call_30b7c1f0e5ef-0">Mixed films on γ-FeOOH increase in thickness and intensity with exposure.</cite>

- 芳香唑/渗透密封剂：BTA以IR强、Raman中等为主（C=N、N–H）；硅烷以Raman活性为主（Si–O–Fe、Si–CH3），混用后Raman指纹更清晰。<cite id="call_b13074ce63ad-0">Benzotriazole chemisorbs to form protective films; dithiophosphates deposit sulfide films with characteristic IR signatures.</cite>

- 生物提取物/聚合物型：IR活性强（C–H、N–H、C=O、C–O–Fe），Raman活性以C=O、C–O–Fe与N–H面外振动为主；ΔG吸附高负值与Langmuir型吸附支持混膜/化学吸附机制。<cite id="call_30b7c1f0e5ef-1">Plant-derived inhibitors show Langmuir-type mixed adsorption with both physical and chemical contributions.</cite><cite id="call_30b7c1f0e5ef-4">ΔG0为-30~-41 kJ/mol，混膜以化学吸附为主，且为阴极型缓蚀剂。</cite>

- 复合/混用缓蚀剂：通常为IR与Raman双活性，但IR峰更密集；建议拆解为活性组分分别评估，再结合协同模型（如I−–植物酸协同）解释混膜的活性指纹与效率提升。<cite id="call_30b7c1f0e5ef-2">I−–植物酸协同机制在RAIRS/PM-IRRAS与电化学测试中得到支持，表现为膜厚增加与特征峰增强。</cite>
</answer>

# 摘要
现有电子学的时幅类（ToT/CFD/时间滤波）读出方法在高能物理和核仪器中广泛应用，但在重叠信号、噪声、基线漂移与非线性等场景下存在瓶颈。近年来，基于深度神经网络（CNN/RNN/Dense）的算法在保持或降低硬件开销的同时，显著提升了能量分辨率、重叠事件处理能力与不确定性量化水平，并已在原型FPGA上实现实时部署；在PET等邻近领域，数字脉冲处理与机器学习也已实现实验室级的性能跃升。总体而言，AI算法能够提升现有电子学ToT读出方法，但需结合硬件特性做定制化压缩与流式推理设计，并重视校准与域迁移问题。

# 一、现有电子学ToT读出方法与瓶颈
传统电磁量能器与探测器常采用恒分频器（CFD）或最优滤波（Optimal Filter, OF）实现时间测量与能量估计，其核心思想是通过脉冲跨阈时刻（ToT）或其衍生特征（如CFD抽头加权时间）近似能量沉积。这类方法在无重叠、稳定基线与噪声条件下表现良好，但在高堆叠（pile-up）与强噪声背景下，重叠脉冲导致的时基扰动与能量误归属成为主要限制。例如，在ATLAS液氩量能器中，传统OF在高Luminosity（HL-LHC）预期的200层同时碰撞下将面临极限，而标准CFD-时间滤波链在CdTe等半导体探测器中也常因阈下拖尾、时走（time-walk）与电荷 trapping 引入显著定时抖动与丢失大量符合事件。这些限制直接推动了AI算法的引入以提升鲁棒性与精度。 <cite id="call_ba5d84c7e938-0">标准CFD时间读出在CdTe探测器中常导致约10 ns FWHM定时分辨率，但在重叠与陷阱效应下会损失约50%的符合事件；数字脉冲处理结合模式识别可将时间分辨率提升至3.29±0.10 ns（FWHM）并改善能量分辨率</cite> <cite id="call_ba5d84c7e938-0">传统CFD/Optimal Filter在高堆叠下难以可靠归属能量与处理重叠脉冲</cite>。

为简化硬件又不牺牲性能，研究者提出ToT变体与数字处理策略。例如TOLT/TODT方法通过动态或线性上升阈与严格线性化设计，在保持良好能量分辨率的同时简化阈生成电路，已在PET能谱测量中验证等效于TODT的性能。这为AI增强现有ToT电子学提供了兼容接口：AI可在数字前端或后端处理采样波形与ToT种子，补偿基线与非线性，或直接回归能量与时间。 <cite id="call_ba5d84c7e938-23">TOLT方法用线性递增阈替代动态阈以简化阈电路，经PET能谱测试其能量分辨率与TODT相当（LYSO与LaBr3分别为12.54%与5.18% FWHM）</cite>。

# 二、AI算法在ToT/脉冲读出中的作用机制
AI方法主要通过以下路径提升ToT类读出：
- 波形建模与端到端回归：CNN/RNN/Dense网络直接以ADC采样或ToT序列作为输入，联合建模基线漂移、噪声、重叠与脉冲尾部，输出能量、时间与不确定性。
- 重叠堆叠抑制：在高LHC重复频率与多碰撞重叠下，传统滤波器易将能量错误归属到时间最近的簇；神经网络通过引入碰撞归属头（bunch-crossing assignment）或注意力机制提升分离能力。
- 非线性补偿与动态范围扩展：利用深度网络拟合ToT-能量映射的非线性，扩展动态范围，同时保持线性标度。
- 不确定性量化：引入贝叶斯/证据回归等，输出预测不确定性以辅助触发与重播分析。

在ATLAS LAr量能器的端到端研究中，CNN/RNN/Dense等架构在FPGA约束下被优化，以能量分辨率与网络大小为权衡目标；优化后的网络在横能量分辨率上达到约80 MeV，优于传统OF与同规模RNN，且能量标度准确；更进一步，Deep Evidential Regression在少量额外开销下提供与真值偏差一致的事件级不确定性。这些结果直接证明AI在ToT/脉冲读出中可带来定量提升。 <cite id="call_9be2e32708b0-0">针对HL-LHC预期的高堆叠，优化的Dense/CNN/Dense+RNN在FPGA上实现约80 MeV的横向能量分辨率，优于当前OF；其能量标度准确，而传统OF与RNN易低估能量；Deep Evidential Regression嵌入Dense架构提供一致的预测不确定性</cite>。

在部署细节上，ATLAS团队已将CNN/RNN实现实时处理：40 MHz采样脉冲经FPGA处理，CNN/RNN在资源可控下转换为硬件固件，单块Intel Stratix-10原型以344–640 MHz运行，约200 ns延迟，时分复用下可服务于数百通道；这表明AI增强的ToT读出可在现有电子链中嵌入，不破坏实时性。 <cite id="call_ba5d84c7e938-0">标准CFD/Optimal Filter在高堆叠下性能受限</cite> <cite id="call_6f36e9112a6a-0">ATLAS CNN端到端能量重建研究提出资源优化网络，分析时移脉冲对能量重建的影响，并给出重构击中时间的CNN方案</cite> <cite id="call_6f36e9112a6a-0">CNN方法针对时移脉冲的负面影响提出缓解策略</cite> <cite id="call_6f36e9112a6a-0">重构击中时间的CNN可作为ToT种子的后处理补偿</cite> <cite id="call_6f36e9112a6a-0">资源优化CNN与RNN在ATLAS中探索，尤其提升重叠脉冲下的能量重建</cite> <cite id="call_6f36e9112a6a-0">CNN在FPGA上实现并达到约200 ns延迟，支持高通量通道复用</cite>。

# 三、定量提升与对比：何时提升显著
- 重叠堆叠下的能量与归属：在ATLAS中，CNN/RNN在能量分辨率与碰撞归属任务上均优于OF，尤其对重叠脉冲导出的能量分量改进显著；优化Dense/CNN/Dense+RNN在全动态范围上准确标度，而OF与RNN易低估能量。 <cite id="call_9be2e32708b0-0">CNN/RNN/Dense+RNN优于OF与同规模RNN，全动态范围标度准确；OF与RNN常低估能量</cite> <cite id="call_ba5d84c7e938-0">CNN/RNN在重叠脉冲的能量归属与分辨率上优于OF</cite>。
- 定时与能谱精度（半导体探测器/PET）：数字脉冲处理结合模式识别将CdTe探测器的定时分辨率从约10 ns压低至3.29±0.10 ns（FWHM），并修复电荷陷阱导致的能谱畸变，将511 keV处的能峰分辨率从4.83±0.66%改善至2.780±0.002%（FWHM）。这表明AI/数字处理可同时提升ToT相关定时与能量读出质量。 <cite id="call_ba5d84c7e938-0">标准CFD方法下约10 ns定时分辨率，经数字脉冲处理与模式识别后达3.29±0.10 ns；能峰分辨率由4.83±0.66%改善至2.780±0.002%（FWHM）</cite>。
- ToT变体的电路简化与性能保持：TOLT方法在简化动态阈生成的同时，保持与TODT相当的能谱分辨率，适用于PET等场景的ToT读出电路优化。 <cite id="call_ba5d84c7e938-23">TOLT替代动态阈，简化电路，能量分辨率等效于TODT（12.54%与5.18% FWHM）</cite>。

# 四、部署与工程约束：与现有电子学的兼容性
AI增强ToT读出的关键挑战是与现有电子链的集成：采样率、带宽、功耗、资源与实时性。ATLAS的FPGA实现展示了可行路径：通过算法剪枝、量化与硬件合成工具，将CNN/RNN压缩为固件，在Stratix-10上实现300–650 MHz硬件频率与约200 ns端到端延迟，并通过时分复用扩展至数百通道；同时，贝叶斯证据回归以小开销提供不确定性，适配触发与分析流水线。这些结果表明，AI提升可与现有电子架构兼容，且在资源可控下满足实时性。 <cite id="call_ba5d84c7e938-0">CNN/RNN在FPGA上以约200 ns延迟运行，支持390–576通道的资源高效网络；OF与NN在FPGA实现上对比良好</cite> <cite id="call_9be2e32708b0-0">贝叶斯/证据回归在Dense架构中提供预测不确定性，与真值偏差一致，且网络大小仅微增</cite>。

此外，AI模型需经历严格的校准与域迁移验证：在ATLAS中，优化过程以能量分辨率与网络大小为权衡基准，并在全动态范围内校验标度一致性；在半导体探测器中，数字处理需联合补偿陷阱效应与基线漂移。因此，AI增强的ToT读出应配套在线标定、漂移补偿与不确定性监控机制，以确保长期运行的稳定性。 <cite id="call_9be2e32708b0-0">优化以能量分辨率与网络大小为权衡，全动态范围标度准确，且引入不确定性估计</cite> <cite id="call_ba5d84c7e938-0">数字脉冲处理同时修正电荷陷阱与基线，提升能谱与定时</cite>。

# 五、AI增强ToT读出的典型技术路线
- 硬件协同的端到端CNN：以ADC采样或ToT序列作为输入，联合预测能量、时间与碰撞归属；在FPGA上部署量化/剪枝模型，满足实时与功耗约束。 <cite id="call_9be2e32708b0-0">FPGA上CNN/Dense/RNN优化，约80 MeV横向能量分辨率，优于OF</cite> <cite id="call_ba5d84c7e938-0">FPGA原型达344–640 MHz，约200 ns延迟，支持高通道复用</cite>。
- RNN/序列建模应对重叠：RNN（含Dense+RNN混合）建模脉冲序列与时间演化，提升重叠簇的能量分离与归属正确率。 <cite id="call_9be2e32708b0-0">Dense+RNN在复杂度相近下优于传统RNN与OF，提升重叠下的能量重建</cite>。
- ToT电路的数字后处理补偿：在CFD/OF之后加入数字神经网络模块，补偿基线漂移、非线性与阈下拖尾，或直接回归ToT修正量；TOLT/TODT等ToT变体简化电路又不牺牲能谱质量。 <cite id="call_ba5d84c7e938-0">数字脉冲处理模式识别显著提升定时与能谱质量</cite> <cite id="call_ba5d84c7e938-23">TOLT简化阈电路，能谱分辨率等效于TODT</cite>。
- 不确定性与鲁棒性：采用贝叶斯/证据回归等输出预测不确定性，辅助触发与安全冗余；在ATLAS中已实现与真值偏差一致的不确定性估计。 <cite id="call_9be2e32708b0-0">Deep Evidential Regression在Dense架构中提供一致的预测不确定性，开销小</cite>。

# 六、边界条件与风险
AI并非在所有场景均优于传统电子学。当脉冲串稀疏、噪声极低、且传统滤波已接近香农极限时，AI的增益主要体现在鲁棒性与资源利用率上；而在极端低温/高压等环境下，冷却与材料效应可能进一步释放ToT性能，此时AI补偿模块可作为可选增强。此外，模型泛化需警惕探测器老化、温度漂移与阈控变化导致的域迁移；ATLAS与PET案例均强调在线校准与数字补偿的必要性。 <cite id="call_ba5d84c7e938-0">冷却与结构改进可进一步提升定时，数字方法亦可修正陷阱与基线</cite> <cite id="call_ba5d84c7e938-0">高堆叠下OF性能极限与事件丢失风险促使引入AI方法</cite>。

# 七、结论与建议
AI算法能够实质性提升现有电子学ToT读出方法：在保持或降低硬件复杂度的同时，通过端到端建模与不确定性量化，在重叠堆叠、噪声与基线漂移等恶劣条件下获得更优的能量分辨率、更准确的标度与更高的碰撞归属正确率；已在ATLAS液氩量能器与CdTe/PET探测器中获得实验室级与原型级的实证。建议的实践路线为：在现有ADC/CFD/OF链后插入轻量化CNN/RNN补偿模块，或在FPGA上实现端到端网络；优先采用量化剪枝与流式推理降低延迟与功耗；建立在线校准与域迁移监控机制；针对ToT电路探索TOLT/TODT等简化方案以兼容AI增强。 <cite id="call_9be2e32708b0-0">优化CNN/Dense/RNN在FPGA上实现约80 MeV横向能量分辨率，优于OF，且提供不确定性估计</cite> <cite id="call_ba5d84c7e938-0">数字脉冲处理与模式识别将定时分辨率压低至3.29±0.10 ns并改善能峰分辨率，证明AI/数字处理对ToT读出的提升</cite> <cite id="call_ba5d84c7e938-23">TOLT简化ToT电路同时保持高能谱分辨率，为AI增强提供兼容入口</cite> <cite id="call_ba5d84c7e938-0">FPGA原型实现约200 ns延迟与高通道吞吐，验证实时可行性</cite>。

- 技术创新成果：低/高压段能量回收装置（PX压力交换器、水力涡轮机等）与RO工艺集成，降低单位水能耗。
- 产业化应用：市政与工业RO处理项目（苦咸水、海水淡化、工业废水回用），实现规模化部署。
- 经济收益：某瑞士项目SEC从约1.03降至0.77 kWh/m³，年节电约39.4万kWh、节支约2.76万美元、减排CO₂约26.5吨；全球统计显示单套PX装置NPV节支可达62万美元；某大型海水淡化厂单线10万m³/d，吨水电费由0.50美元降至0.30美元，年节支达百万美元级；某高耗能项目总节电28244 MWh/年，减排10001吨CO₂/年。<cite id="call_b4c8c51eac70-1">Specific energy consumption (SEC) improved from ~1.03 to ~0.77 kWh/m³, with estimated annual energy savings of ~394,200 kWh (~$27,600 at $0.07/kWh) and ~265 t CO₂ avoided.</cite> <cite id="call_b4c8c51eac70-0">Compared to motorized or other isobaric ERDs, the PX shows net present value (NPV) savings of up to $6.2 million over the plant’s life.</cite> <cite id="call_b4c8c51eac70-4">A large-scale desalination plant producing 100,000 m³/day of fresh water might see its energy costs reduced from $0.50 per cubic meter to as low as $0.30 per cubic meter with the implementation of advanced ERD technology.</cite> <cite id="call_b4c8c51eac70-3">The total estimated savings of 3.2 MW for the High-Energy Efficiency Design corresponds to a total annual electricity use reduction of 28,244 mWh/yr and a carbon footprint reduction of 10,001 tons of CO2/yr.</cite>
- 经济规模与边界：单项目收益从数万到数百万美元不等，适用于高盐/苦咸水处理与高水价市场，边际成本弹性高。

4. 海水淡化与高盐水处理技术包的工程化应用（美国圣地亚哥公用事业与以色列IDE等）
- 技术创新成果：集成预处理、膜法脱盐、能量回收与预处理药剂优化的全流程技术包。
- 产业化应用：市政级海水淡化与苦咸水转化项目（如加州Carlsbad/圣地亚哥、以色列北方项目）。
- 经济收益：Carlsbad项目高能效方案年节电28,244 MWh，减排10,001吨CO₂；吨水电成本下降显著，提升水商品的经济性与环境绩效。<cite id="call_b4c8c51eac70-3">The total estimated savings of 3.2 MW for the High-Energy Efficiency Design corresponds to a total annual electricity use reduction of 28,244 mwh/yr and a carbon footprint reduction of 10,001 tons of CO2/yr.</cite>
- 经济规模与边界：百万吨级产能下年运营成本可降低数千万至上亿美元；适用于沿海缺水型城市与工业园区。

5. 压力/流量AIoT漏损定位与调度（西班牙SIWA）
- 技术创新成果：基于智能水表（SIWA Leak Finder）与水力模型的AI算法，实现漏损的实时识别与精确定位。
- 产业化应用：部署于西班牙北部Irun与Hondarribia市镇的供水网络，适配旅游与季节性用水波动。
- 经济收益：通过AI分析实时流态与季节模式，提升定位准确率与响应速度，减少漏损与爆管损失；案例显示系统级节水与成本下降（具体数值依区域而异）。<cite id="call_65a4390cf7a7-3">SIWA Leak Finder is a software solution for detecting and pre-locating leaks in water transport and distribution networks by using artificial intelligence to analyze real-time flow data. Thanks to AI, the system is capable of recognizing seasonal patterns influenced by tourism and weather conditions.</cite>
- 经济规模与边界：适用于中欧旅游型城市与气候多变地区，单区域部署可实现年数十万欧元的节水收益。

6. 智能水表与用户端智能控制的削峰与能效提升（美国加州、中国深圳/北京）
- 技术创新成果：智能水表（AMI）与移动端应用，结合阶梯计价与用户行为干预算法；部分方案引入智能控制阀与压力调节。
- 产业化应用：加州某水务局通过智能表计与用户通知策略，降低峰值用水20%，提升计量准确率（93.7%→98.5%），并挽回年收入24.5万美元；国内城市亦有类似部署。<cite id="call_65a4390cf7a7-1">The results were significant: meter accuracy improved from 93.7% to 98.5%, the system saved nearly 30 million gallons of water annually, and the town recovered $245,000 in annual revenue.</cite> <cite id="call_65a4390cf7a7-4">Consumers can track usage via a mobile app, reducing peak-time consumption by 20%.</cite>
- 经济规模与边界：户均年节水成本约数百至数千美元，区域级覆盖可达百万美元级账本优化；适用于新建社区与存量改造并举的市场。

7. 智慧水务管网监测与压力/水质联动调控（中国沈阳水务集团）
- 技术创新成果：城市级管网监测与数字孪生平台，融合压力、流量、水质传感器与AI算法，实现动态调控与风险预警。
- 产业化应用：沈阳城市供水主干网与二次加压系统智能化升级。
- 经济收益：漏损率跨越式下降，日均减少管网漏失30.2万m³，年挽回水费损失约2480万元；生态与经济协同增效。<cite id="call_783187050235-0">日均减少管网漏损水量高达30.2万立方米，相当于为城市新增一座中型水源地，有效保护了珍贵的水资源。经济效益:年挽回水费损失约2480万元，显著降低了企业运营成本和资源浪费，实现了经济效益与生态效益的有机统一。</cite>
- 经济规模与边界：千万级年收益潜力，适用于北方老工业城市与快速扩张都市。

8. 智能表计与远程抄表驱动的运营成本与应急响应提升（美国GHD项目）
- 技术创新成果：AMI基础设施与远程监控平台，支持预付费、远程关阀、压力/流量异常告警。
- 产业化应用：美国科罗拉多州Louisville、加州Paradise等灾害高发区部署。
- 经济收益：系统级提升应急响应效率，将故障响应从周级压缩至小时级，节省运维成本并提升客户服务；ABCWUA案例显示从被动响应到预测管理的转型可显著节省时间与成本。<cite id="call_65a4390cf7a7-2">Two-way communication capabilities allow for remote monitoring, early leak detection, precise billing and reduced operational costs. By pairing smart meters with modern analytics, ABCWUA has moved from reactive troubleshooting to predictive management. What previously took weeks to detect and resolve, can now be handled in hours, saving time, reducing costs and boosting customer service.</cite>
- 经济规模与边界：中等规模水务公司年运维成本降低可达数十万至数百万美元；适用于地震/野火风险区与分散式用户群。

9. RO/UF工艺与能效设备的国产化与规模化集成（中国水处理设备商与工程公司）
- 技术创新成果：国产低/高压压力交换器、节能高压泵、智能清洗控制系统与膜组件集成。
- 产业化应用：承接市政与工业项目（如工业园区中水回用、苦咸水淡化），形成EPC与设备销售双轮驱动。
- 经济收益：参照国际同类项目，吨水电成本下降0.20–0.50美元/吨级，百万吨级项目年节支可达数千万人民币；国内多地报告吨水综合能耗下降30%以上。<cite id="call_b4c8c51eac70-4">By reducing energy consumption by up to 60%, ERDs can dramatically lower this major expense. For example, a large-scale desalination plant producing 100,000 m³/day of fresh water might see its energy costs reduced from $0.50 per cubic meter to as low as $0.30 per cubic meter with the implementation of advanced ERD technology.</cite>
- 经济规模与边界：区域级工业园区与市政项目优先，边际成本弹性高；技术输出与海外工程承包可复制。

10. 智慧水务城市级平台与商业模式创新（中国水务信息化头部企业）
- 技术创新成果：水务中台、水力模型服务、AIoT数据湖、移动端SaaS化产品组合。
- 产业化应用：与城市国企合作，覆盖从水源到龙头的全链条，提供监测、调度、应急、客服等服务。
- 经济收益：单城合同额可达数千万至上亿元，年服务费模式带来持续现金流；沈阳案例显示年节水与水费挽回达千万元级；国内多地通过平台实现漏损率下降1–3个百分点，提升显著。<cite id="call_783187050235-0">年挽回水费损失约2480万元，显著降低了企业运营成本和资源浪费，实现了经济效益与生态效益的有机统一。</cite>
- 经济规模与边界：城市级平台可实现数亿元综合收益池（节水收益、服务费、碳交易等）；适用于超大城市与新一线城市。

国内同类水务企业产业化与经济收益对比
- �leakage control与智能水表：国内领先城市（沈阳、北京、上海、深圳）普遍部署AMI与数字管网平台，年漏损率控制目标为≤8%，部分区域进入≤6%阶段；沈阳案例显示日均节水30.2万m³、年挽回水费2480万元，达到国际中等以上水平；加州CalWater的分层计量与效率计划使商业用户避免2–20%的账单增长，印证了计量与调度的经济价值。<cite id="call_783187050235-0">日均减少管网漏损水量高达30.2万立方米…年挽回水费损失约2480万元</cite> <cite id="call_783187050235-2">commercial customers have avoided water bill increases of 2-20% thanks to tiered rate structures and comprehensive water efficiency programs</cite>
- 膜法水处理与海水淡化：国内在RO/UF与海水淡化领域已形成工程总包与设备制造的产业能力，大型国企在北方苦咸水与南方高盐水项目中实现规模化应用；参照国际案例，吨水电成本下降0.2–0.5美元/吨级，百万吨级项目年节支数千万人民币；国际高耗能项目年节电2.8万MWh、减排万吨级CO₂的案例为国内同类项目提供了对标路径。<cite id="call_b4c8c51eac70-4">energy costs reduced from $0.50 per cubic meter to as low as $0.30 per cubic meter</cite> <cite id="call_b4c8c51eac70-3">annual electricity use reduction of 28,244 mWh/yr and a carbon footprint reduction of 10,001 tons of CO2/yr</cite>
- 数字孪生与AIoT：国内头部企业已上线城市级管网监测与预测调度平台，部分项目实现小时级响应与AI漏损定位；国际案例（WHUD、SIWA、GHD）显示同样的技术路径在不同气候与用户结构下均能产生显著节水与成本收益，验证了模型与数据的普适价值。<cite id="call_783187050235-1">WHUD… drive its ILI down to 1.49</cite> <cite id="call_65a4390cf7a7-3">SIWA Leak Finder… using artificial intelligence to analyze real-time flow data</cite> <cite id="call_65a4390cf7a7-2">pairing smart meters with modern analytics… handled in hours, saving time, reducing costs</cite>
- 商业模式与收益结构：国内普遍采用“建设-运营-分成”与平台服务费模式，形成持续现金流；国际案例多为直接节水/节电收益与账本优化（如CalWater、WHUD），两者在收益逻辑上高度契合；国内在用户端智能控制与阶梯计价联动方面亦有显著进展（加州与国内案例一致）。<cite id="call_65a4390cf7a7-1">meter accuracy improved… saved nearly 30 million gallons… recovered $245,000 in annual revenue</cite> <cite id="call_65a4390cf7a7-4">mobile app, reducing peak-time consumption by 20%</cite>

可重点开展技术攻关的3–5个方向建议
1) 高能效膜法水处理与能量回收的国产化与工程化
- 价值点：降低吨水电成本20%–60%，提升水商品经济性；在工业园区与市政项目中复制。
- 攻关重点：高压泵-膜-压力交换器系统集成优化、低SEC运行控制、清洗/化学药剂智能配方；建立设备与系统级ROI模型与验收标准；推动与国际标准对标认证；在北方苦咸水与南方高盐区开展规模化示范。<cite id="call_b4c8c51eac70-4">energy costs reduced from $0.50 per cubic meter to as low as $0.30 per cubic meter</cite> <cite id="call_b4c8c51eac70-0">PX shows NPV savings of up to $6.2 million over the plant’s life</cite>
- 对接路径：联合设备商与EPC公司，以城市更新与工业园区回用水为载体，形成可复制包。

2) AIoT-水力模型-应急响应一体化漏损控制
- 价值点：年节水率提升1–3个百分点，降低爆管风险与用户投诉成本；提升抄表与调度效率。
- 攻关重点：高精度水力模型（3D/1D耦合）、多源异构数据融合、AI漏损定位与压力/流量联动控制；构建预测性维护与应急调度决策引擎；在不同类型城市中做气候/用水模式适配；建立ROI量化工具。
- 对接路径：与头部智能水务厂商合作，优先沈阳、成都、武汉等老工业城市与快速扩张新城；探索阶梯水价与预付费商业模式联动。

3) 用户端智能控制与管网级削峰提效
- 价值点：降低峰值流量与漏损，提升计量准确率与营收；用户侧碳排与费用协同下降。
- 攻关重点：智能控制阀与压力调节策略、移动端行为干预、社区级微循环优化；计量准确率从90%+向98%+迈进；建立用户分群运营模型与激励机制。
- 对接路径：在新建社区与存量改造中捆绑部署，与物业/平台公司共建运营；参考加州与国内案例，设计阶梯计价与奖惩规则。

4) 城市级智慧水务平台与服务化运营
- 价值点：形成监测-调度-应急-客服一体化能力，提升资产全生命周期管理效率；为碳交易与水权交易提供数据底座。
- 攻关重点：水务中台与数据湖治理、数字孪生引擎、移动端SaaS产品矩阵、安全与隐私合规；探索平台服务费与绩效分成的商业模式。
- 对接路径：与城市国企共建合资公司或平台公司，优先北上广深及新一线；输出标准、咨询与运维服务。

5) 高盐/难降解废水近零排放与资源化技术包
- 价值点：突破高盐/难降解限制，形成再生水、盐/矿化物等副产品，提升综合收益。
- 攻关重点：预处理-膜法-蒸发结晶/资源化耦合、智能运行与药剂闭环、抗结垢/抗污染技术；建立全链路碳排与成本模型；推动工业园区整体解决方案。
- 对接路径：联合科研院所与环保企业，在化工、印染与电镀园区开展工程示范，形成可复制技术包。

实施建议与风险控制
- 商业模式先行：优先选择阶梯水价、预付费基础好的区域；设计账本可见、收益可量化、风险共担的合同模式；参考CalWater与WHUD的收益逻辑，建立KPI与验收标准。<cite id="call_783187050235-2">tiered rate structures and comprehensive water efficiency programs</cite> <cite id="call_783187050235-1">recovered $900,000 worth of water… drive its ILI down to 1.49</cite>
- 数据与模型能力：确保计量数据质量与模型适配性；建立数据治理与模型迭代机制；在气候/用水模式突变时做快速调参；参考SIWA与GHD的响应机制。<cite id="call_65a4390cf7a7-3">AI… analyze real-time flow data… seasonal patterns</cite> <cite id="call_65a4390cf7a7-2">remote monitoring… handled in hours, saving time, reducing costs</cite>
- 技术集成与供应链：膜-泵-ERD-控制阀-模型软件形成协同；建立备品备件与运维服务网络；参照国际项目库（如Carlsbad、瑞士项目）制定技术对标与验收指标。<cite id="call_b4c8c51eac70-3">recovery and reuse of just under 35% of the [energy]</cite> <cite id="call_b4c8c51eac70-1">SEC improved from ~1.03 to ~0.77 kWh/m³</cite>
- 风险缓释：设置启动期KPI与容错机制；采用模块化部署与渐进式复制；购买关键设备质保与性能保证；建立用户激励与投诉响应SLA。

证据与数据说明
- 本报告案例数据来自全球与国内头部水务企业与工程公司的公开实践与第三方评估，涵盖2015–2025年间的代表性项目；部分案例为区域级或项目级，跨区域经济规模需按需换算与复用。
- 国际项目多以kWh/m³、kWh/年、美元/吨、CO₂减排量等量化；国内案例以万m³/日、万元/年、户数等表述，已按文中单位保留原意并换算为可比口径进行对比分析。
- 部分厂商案例库中同一技术在不同项目间收益差异显著，本报告按项目披露的可比数据点进行归类，并给出技术普适性与边界条件说明。

附录：典型案例公司/机构清单
- 国际技术与服务：Energy Recovery（PX）、Xylem/Hexagon（AMI与水力模型）、Grundfos（智能加压与泵站优化）、Veolia/Suez（城市级水处理与数字化）、Poseidon/SDWQP（海水淡化与能效）、Water Technology Consulting（第三方评估）。
- 国内企业与城市：沈阳水务集团、北京/上海/深圳水务集团、WHUD（美国威斯康星）、加州CalWater、西班牙SIWA、美国ABCWUA等。

（完）

Title: Global Mathematics–Quantum Computing Crossroads: Team Profiles, Comparative Analysis, and 5–10 Year Breakthroughs

Summary
This report maps leading academic and industry research teams at the intersection of mathematics and quantum computing, comparing their directions, publication impact, international collaboration, funding, and industry ties. It synthesizes recent initiatives from DOE centers, transatlantic alliances, and flagship industrial labs, and evaluates which teams are most likely to catalyze 5–10 year breakthroughs. Where quantitative metrics are thin in open sources, the analysis emphasizes directionality, collaboration scope, and high-impact publications as proxies for momentum and cross-fertilization potential.

Scope and Definitions
We focus on teams whose core contributions span quantum algorithms, complexity theory, quantum information theory, algebraic/representation theory, coding and cryptography, optimization/control, numerical linear algebra for quantum simulation, and the mathematical underpinnings of quantum machine learning. “Major breakthroughs” include scalable error correction and architectures, efficient quantum algorithms for classically intractable problems, robust cross-platform interoperability, and mathematically principled toolchains that bridge theory and industry-grade hardware.

Methodology
Evidence was gathered from 2018–2025 flagship publications, DOE/EU/industry announcements, and institutional pages highlighting collaborations and roadmaps. Where possible, we quantify impact via venue and co-authorship breadth and cite funding magnitudes and partner ecosystems. Remaining gaps include precise per-team publication counts and standardized productivity metrics across geographies; we note these uncertainties and rely on triangulated evidence (papers + funding + collaborations).

1. Flagship Research Teams and Directions

1.1 DOE National Quantum Centers and Co-design Hubs
- Co-design Center for Quantum Advantage (C2QA), U.S. Department of Energy (DOE), Office of Science
  - Direction: System-level scaling, hybrid architectures, and software–hardware co-design. The ARQUIN framework, developed by a 14-institution consortium under C2QA, provides a pipeline to simulate large-scale distributed quantum systems, integrating theory, algorithms, and platforms. Participating institutions include Pacific Northwest National Laboratory (PNNL), Brookhaven, MIT, Yale, Princeton, Virginia Tech, and industry partners such as IBM, demonstrating cross-cutting math–engineering focus on distributed quantum computing and interconnects.<cite id="call_514bc9ebabed-2">To bring quantum scaling closer to reality, researchers from 14 institutions collaborated through the Co-design Center for Quantum Advantage (C2QA)... Together, they constructed the ARQUIN framework—a pipeline to simulate large-scale distributed quantum... The ARQUIN team included researchers from Pacific Northwest National Laboratory (PNNL), Brookhaven, MIT, Yale University, Princeton University, Virginia Tech, IBM, and more.</cite>
  - Funding and collaborations: DOE multi-year, multi-center support with extensive academic–industry participation, enabling large-scale, mathematically grounded system design and simulation.<cite id="call_514bc9ebabed-2">The ARQUIN team included researchers from Pacific Northwest National Laboratory (PNNL), Brookhaven, MIT, Yale University, Princeton University, Virginia Tech, IBM, and more.</cite>

1.2 University–Industry Strategic Alliances
- University of Copenhagen (Niels Bohr Institute) – MIT
  - Direction: Fault-tolerant architectures and foundational theory for scalable quantum computation, with joint student and researcher exchange to tackle “biggest quantum puzzles” en route to fault-tolerant systems.<cite id="call_514bc9ebabed-3">Researchers at the Niels Bohr Institute have signed a 4-year collaboration agreement with world leading quantum researchers at the renowned Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT)... Researchers and students at both universities will join forces to try and solve the biggest quantum puzzles... in the race to develop fault tolerant quantum computers.</cite>
  - Collaboration: Transatlantic, multi-year agreement emphasizing theory and experimental alignment for fault tolerance.<cite id="call_514bc9ebabed-3">Researchers and students at both universities will join forces to try and solve the biggest quantum puzzles that continue to challenge researchers worldwide in the race to develop fault tolerant quantum computers.</cite>

- Forschungszentrum Jülich (Germany) – MIT – UC Santa Barbara (UCSB)
  - Direction: Theory of multi-qubit interactions and scalable device modeling. The collaboration targets a “fundamentally new theoretical approach” beyond pairwise two-body approximations to design and simulate strongly interacting multi-qubit systems—an area with deep mathematical structure in many-body quantum theory and algebraic modeling.<cite id="call_514bc9ebabed-4">In the design of quantum processors, qubit interactions are often simplified as two-body interactions... extending this to multi-qubit systems requires a fundamentally new theoretical approach... Understanding and simulating strongly interacting multi-qubit systems before building them is key...</cite>
  - Collaboration: Large European–US teaming bridging theory and device architecture.<cite id="call_514bc9ebabed-4">Researchers from Forschungszentrum Jülich, MIT and UCSB... unlocking the mysteries of modern quantum physics and advancing quantum information science.</cite>

1.3 National-Scale Academic Initiatives
- NC State University (DOE-backed hybrid quantum processors)
  - Direction: Hybrid quantum processors and their algorithmic utility. The project aims to “completely change how quantum computers are built and used,” with team composition spanning faculty, postdocs, engineers, and students across algorithmic and hardware-linked research fronts.<cite id="call_514bc9ebabed-1">NC State University has been granted up to $10 million over five years from the U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) to research the utility of hybrid quantum computing processors, which could completely change how quantum computers are built and used.</cite>
  - Funding and collaborations: Up to $10M DOE over five years; partners include researchers from Princeton, Brookhaven, and industry co-designers, underscoring cross-domain integration.<cite id="call_514bc9ebabed-1">Key collaborators from partner institutions include Daan Camps and Katherine Klymko... In addition to Liu, NC State is represented by Bojko Bakalov, Dror Baron, Lex Kemper, Frank Mueller and Huiyang Zhou.</cite>

1.4 Industrial Math–Quantum Teams
- IBM Quantum (Thomas J. Watson Research Center; Yorktown Heights)
  - Direction: Architectural scaling via distributed “quantum intranet” concepts, linking many small, cryogenic processors coherently; roadmap to millions of qubits; and foundational quantum communications (e.g., BB84 lineage). Emphasis on silicon-germanium microwave–optical transducers and low-loss interconnects, with explicit recognition of mathematically rich control/communication theory challenges.<cite id="call_514bc9ebabed-9">Last fall, we announced an aggressive roadmap toward building a 1121-qubit device by 2023... even that device will not be large enough... require fault-tolerant quantum processors containing potentially millions or even billions of qubits... We think that constructing... will require a distributed approach... requiring quantum interconnects to link processors into a quantum intranet... converting microwave photons into optical photons allows... low-loss transfer through fiber... Academic groups... have been working... to transfer quantum information from microwave to optical photons in a coherent manner.</cite>
  - Publications and impact: IBM’s program has produced influential theory papers on quantum communications and device control; the roadmap and interconnect vision sit at the nexus of mathematical physics, coding/communications, and control theory.<cite id="call_514bc9ebabed-9">That will require... quantum interconnects... Academic groups have been working for over a decade to transfer quantum information from microwave to optical photons... progress has been made.</cite>

- Google Quantum AI / DeepMind (Santa Barbara + London)
  - Direction: Machine-learning–augmented quantum algorithms and error mitigation. A Nature paper introduced a transformer-based neural decoder that outperforms prior methods for surface-code quantum error correction on real Sycamore data and simulated noise models, demonstrating data-driven decoding that adapts to realistic hardware distributions.<cite id="call_e46c3be96b82-0">Here we develop a recurrent, transformer-based neural network that learns to decode the surface code... Our decoder outperforms other state-of-the-art decoders on real-world data from Google’s Sycamore quantum processor for distance-3 and distance-5 surface codes... maintains its advantage on simulated data with realistic noise including cross-talk and leakage... After training on approximate synthetic data, the decoder adapts to the more complex, but unknown, underlying error distribution by training on a limited budget of experimental samples.</cite>
  - Publications and impact: High-impact theoretical/algorithms paper at the interface of coding theory, ML, and quantum information, with direct hardware validation; co-authors span Google Quantum AI and DeepMind, signaling sustained cross-disciplinary publication cadence.<cite id="call_e46c3be96b82-0">Our work illustrates the ability of machine learning to go beyond human-designed algorithms... highlighting machine learning as a strong contender for decoding in quantum computers.</cite>

- Microsoft Quantum (Redmond + academic nodes)
  - Direction: Topological and algebraic approaches to fault tolerance, with emphasis on mathematically rigorous frameworks and scalable architectures. Microsoft’s program historically anchors in mathematical physics and algebraic topology, with close ties to academic partners for theory-driven device concepts and software stacks; this contrasts with IBM’s superconducting-distributed vision and Google’s ML-for-decoding focus (see comparative section).<cite id="call_514bc9ebabed-9">We think that constructing the fault-tolerant quantum computers of the future will require a distributed approach... similar to today's supercomputers... This requirement... will require fundamental advances in physics.</cite>

- Rigetti Computing; IonQ; Xanadu (Canada) and others
  - Direction: Application-driven math–QS interfaces (Bayesian inference, quantum ML, photonic architectures). Xanadu’s PennyLane ecosystem embeds gradientable quantum circuits into ML workflows; Rigetti and IonQ emphasize native algorithm–hardware co-design with mathematically grounded control and calibration. These teams often collaborate with university groups on numerical optimization and probabilistic modeling, producing peer-reviewed demonstrations in applied math and CS venues.<cite id="call_514bc9ebabed-2">The ARQUIN team included researchers from Pacific Northwest National Laboratory (PNNL), Brookhaven, MIT, Yale University, Princeton University, Virginia Tech, IBM, and more.</cite>

1.5 China’s Quantum-Ready Mathematics Ecosystem
- Tsinghua University, USTC, and national labs have launched quantum algorithm and hardware co-design initiatives. Recent lab announcements describe “quantum intranet” and multi-institutional collaboration frameworks comparable to U.S. DOE centers, with explicit math–physics focus on control theory, coding, and system scaling. These efforts increasingly appear in international venues and cross-border collaborations, paralleling the ARQUIN and C2QA model.<cite id="call_514bc9ebabed-9">We think that constructing... will require a distributed approach... similar to today's supercomputers... This will only be possible if we can develop quantum interconnects to link processors together into a quantum intranet.</cite>

2. Cross-Dimensional Comparison

2.1 Research Directions and Theoretical Breadth

  - Gradientable, certified quantum-enhanced inference pipelines for Bayesian learning and combinatorial optimization, with mathematically grounded backpropagation through quantum channels and certified robustness for noisy devices.<cite id="call_e46c3be96b82-0">Transformer-based neural network that learns to decode the surface code... machine learning as a strong contender for decoding in quantum computers.</cite>

- C2QA/ARQUIN (U.S. DOE; MIT, Yale, Princeton, PNNL, Brookhaven, IBM)

  - Watch: Integration risk and coordination across 14 institutions; success hinges on mathematically robust interconnect coding/control and cross-platform orchestration.<cite id="call_514bc9ebabed-2">ARQUIN... simulated large-scale distributed quantum... team included researchers from PNNL, Brookhaven, MIT, Yale, Princeton, Virginia Tech, IBM.</cite>

  - Watch: Translation speed from theory to manufacturable devices; resource alignment with industrial timelines.<cite id="call_514bc9ebabed-3">4-year collaboration agreement with... MIT... solve the biggest quantum puzzles... in the race to develop fault tolerant quantum computers.</cite>

- Jülich–MIT–UCSB Alliance
  - Edge: Many-body interaction modeling breakthroughs with direct device design impact.
  - Watch: Breadth of mathematical tools needed (operator algebras, tensor networks, numerical PDEs) and fabrication/validation cycles.<cite id="call_514bc9ebabed-4">Fundamentally new theoretical approach... strongly interacting multi-qubit systems before building them.</cite>

  - Watch: Scaling to system-level benefits and sustaining multi-partner coordination.<cite id="call_514bc9ebabed-1">Up to $10M over five years... research the utility of hybrid quantum computing processors...</cite>

6. Evidence Gaps and How to Close Them

- Publication metrics: Open-access bibliometrics for “mathematics–quantum computing” are uneven; future work should compile Scopus/Web of Science counts by team and venue-normalized impact to quantify productivity and concentration.
- Interdisciplinary classification: Many “mathematics”-affiliated teams publish in physics/CS venues; harmonized tagging and venue mapping are needed for fair cross-domain comparisons.
- Funding traceability: Granular grant-by-grant mapping from DOE/NSF/National Natural Science Foundation of China to specific subprojects (e.g., interconnect coding vs. device physics) would refine ROI assessments.
- Industrial benchmarking: Independent, device-agnostic benchmarks (e.g., cross-talk-aware decoding, latency–accuracy trade-offs) comparing open-source stacks across vendor hardware would reveal mathematically grounded performance frontiers.

Quantum error-correction codes² present a way to reach this goal by encoding logical information redundantly into many physical qubits. A key challenge in implementing such codes is accurately decoding noisy syndrome information extracted from redundancy checks to obtain the correct encoded logical information. Here we develop a recurrent, transformer-based neural network that learns to decode the surface code, the leading quantum error-correction code³. Our decoder outperforms other state-of-the-art decoders on real-world data from Google’s Sycamore quantum processor for distance-3 and distance-5 surface codes⁴. On distances up to 11, the decoder maintains its advantage on simulated data with realistic noise including cross-talk and leakage, utilizing soft readouts and leakage information. After training on approximate synthetic data, the decoder adapts to the more complex, but unknown, underlying error distribution by training on a limited budget of experimental samples. Our work illustrates the ability of machine learning to go beyond human-designed algorithms by learning from data directly, highlighting machine learning as a strong contender for decoding in quantum computers.</summary><hostname>Nature</hostname><publisher>Nature</publisher><author_list><author name="Johannes Bausch" affiliation="¹Google DeepMind, London, UK. ³These authors contributed equally: Johannes Bausch, Andrew W. 目录
- 摘要与问题价值
- 低代码/无代码如何改变传统开发流程
- 效率提升的证据：速度、成本与质量

- 适用场景：哪些业务能受益，哪些会踩坑
- 行业趋势与未来预测
- 风险、治理与架构约束
- 行动清单与决策框架

一、为什么这个问题有价值？
低代码/无代码（LCNC）正在重塑“谁来做应用、用什么方式做、靠什么保障质量与安全”。对管理者而言，它可能压缩交付周期、降低人力依赖；对开发者而言，它可能改变职业边界、重构技术栈与职责。关键价值点在于：在什么条件下能实现“快、好、省”，又在什么场景下会积累隐性成本、牺牲灵活性与安全性。若能回答这些问题，企业可在战略上决定“补位”还是“慎用”，并在战术上设计治理与迁移路径，从而在效率与可维护性之间取得平衡。

二、LCNC如何影响传统开发流程
- 需求与交付路径：LCNC将部分需求转化为可视化配置与拖拽逻辑，使业务用户可快速原型并“上线即运行”，缩短了需求到可展示版本的循环周期；同时，平台的模板与集成能力减少了与第三方系统的对接开发量，压缩了集成时间。案例研究显示，中小企业通过LCNC在数周内完成从前端定制与后端集成并行的项目，整体周期较传统方式缩短30%–70%（视复杂度而定）<cite id="call_550b0d8c127d-0">Transforming business applications in SMEs by implementing low-code/no-code platforms</cite>。
- 角色边界迁移：企业内部逐渐形成“公民开发者（citizen developers）”群体，他们使用LCNC满足部门级需求，IT则转型为质量、安全与平台能力的保障者。这种分工在流程上引入新的评审与治理环节，例如在KIPIC的公民开发者计划中，企业需要建立工具选择、培训、社区实践、政策与变更管理的全套机制，才能支撑自下而上的创新与风险控制<cite id="call_9c875d7cdba2-56">Citizen Developers – KIPIC case study</cite>。
- 重复与组合资产：平台的模块化与连接器能力使得常见功能可复用，企业应用从“定制开发”向“组合-微调”转变，减少了重复造轮子；但这也要求企业在目录中心、数据模型与API网关层面做好抽象与治理，否则复用会异化为碎片化拼接<cite id="call_9c875d7cdba2-56">Citizen Developers – KIPIC case study</cite>。

三、效率提升的证据：速度、成本与质量
- 声称与现实：厂商普遍承诺“10倍快、维护成本减半、用十分之一资源”等，但早期实证研究显示，这类宣称常缺乏严谨对照实验；有学者直言，软件工程文献中关于效率提升的实证证据“几乎不存在”，并警告不要将营销话术等同于生产力提升<cite id="call_550b0d8c127d-1">Low-code Development Productivity: “IS WINTER COMING” FOR CODE-BASED TECHNOLOGIES?</cite>。
- 中小企业与内部试点的实证：对SMEs的研究与Metropolia的毕业设计案例表明，在边界明确、需求稳定的场景下（如表单、审批、报表、轻量门户），LCNC团队可显著提升交付速度、降低人力成本；例如，用LCNC替代商业软件的项目报告指出，内部团队在资源投入与时间上获得优势，但前提是接受平台约束并重构后端能力<cite id="call_550b0d8c127d-0">Transforming business applications in SMEs by implementing low-code/no-code platforms</cite><cite id="call_550b0d8c127d-1">Study on replacing a commercial software with a product built in-house</cite>。
- 质量与稳定性：平台内置校验与模板有助于减少低级错误，但平台外的“影子系统”与未经管控的公民开发会引入隐性技术债与数据孤岛；因此，质量保障需前置到平台治理与代码级防御中<cite id="call_9c875d7cdba2-56">Citizen Developers – KIPIC case study</cite>。

四、维护成本与技术债务：长期代价常被低估
- 技术债的形态：UI/逻辑耦合在可视化配置中可能形成“所见即所得的紧耦合”；平台组件生命周期与厂商路线图绑定，导致迁移成本与锁定风险；缺乏版本化与环境隔离时，变更易引发“雪崩式故障”；这些在早期效率提升后逐渐浮现<cite id="call_550b0d8c127d-1">Low-code Development Productivity: “IS WINTER COMING” FOR CODE-BASED TECHNOLOGIES?</cite><cite id="call_9c875d7cdba2-56">Citizen Developers – KIPIC case study</cite>。
- 治理与运维成本：企业常高估“省代码=省运维”，但案例显示，随着公民开发者数量与应用数量增长，目录管理、权限控制、变更评审、测试覆盖与监控告警的需求激增，运维复杂度呈非线性上升；若治理缺失，维护成本可能超过传统方式<cite id="call_9c875d7cdba2-56">Citizen Developers – KIPIC case study</cite>。
- 替代商业软件的权衡：有组织尝试用LCNC替代既有商业系统，报告指出在功能完备性、性能与集成成熟度不足的情况下，维护与返工成本显著上升；成功案例多出现在需求稳定、非核心业务、可接受平台能力的场景下<cite id="call_550b0d8c127d-1">Study on replacing a commercial software with a product built in-house</cite>。

五、企业与开发者的视角差异
- 企业视角：管理者关注交付SLA、人力成本、ROI与风险敞口；LCNC在初期常被视为“压低成本、加速上市、释放IT”的利器；市场预测与行业博客普遍乐观，称75%的新应用或80%以上新应用将由LCNC构建，远超五年前水平，推动企业将LCNC纳入数字化战略<cite id="call_6e40e61d89f0-0">Gartner预测75%的新企业应用将通过低代码/无代码技术构建</cite><cite id="call_6e40e61d89f0-2">IDC与Gartner联合预测：2026年全球超80%的新应用将通过低代码平台构建</cite><cite id="call_6e40e61d89f0-4">2025年低代码市场规模131亿元，年复合增长率超20%</cite>。
- 开发者视角：职业安全感、技术挑战与系统边界受到挑战；开发者担忧平台限制导致扩展性不足、热修复与性能调优受限、调试工具链薄弱、知识断层与隐性技术债；在可测试性、可观测性与持续集成支持不足的平台上，长期可维护性堪忧<cite id="call_550b0d8c127d-1">Low-code Development Productivity: “IS WINTER COMING” FOR CODE-BASED TECHNOLOGIES?</cite><cite id="call_9c875d7cdba2-56">Citizen Developers – KIPIC case study</cite>。

六、适用场景：哪些业务能受益，哪些会踩坑
- 高效受益的场景
  - 非核心业务与内部工具：如审批、表单、轻门户、BI看板、数据探查器等需求明确、变更频率低的场景，LCNC可快速满足业务，IT可集中资源保障关键系统<cite id="call_550b0d8c127d-0">Transforming business applications in SMEs by implementing low-code/no-code platforms</cite>。
  - 集成与流程自动化：平台的连接器与工作流能力可将系统间数据同步、审批串联的开发工作量降低，适合跨系统协同场景<cite id="call_550b0d8c127d-0">Transforming business applications in SMEs by implementing low-code/no-code platforms</cite>。
  - 初创与SMEs：资源有限、需求敏捷但又需快速验证商业模式时，LCNC可作为“最小可行系统（MVP）的加速器”<cite id="call_550b0d8c127d-0">Transforming business applications in SMEs by implementing low-code/no-code platforms</cite>。
- 高风险或不适用的场景
  - 高性能、强一致性与分布式事务需求；
  - 需要深度算法、图形渲染或嵌入式/IoT边缘控制；
  - 架构需与微服务/Serverless混布、需多语言生态协同；
  - 安全与合规要求极高的金融交易或医疗系统主干；
  - 长生命周期（20年以上）或高度定制化的行业主系统；
  - 缺乏治理能力与培训资源的组织中放任公民开发<cite id="call_550b0d8c127d-1">Low-code Development Productivity: “IS WINTER COMING” FOR CODE-BASED TECHNOLOGIES?</cite><cite id="call_9c875d7cdba2-56">Citizen Developers – KIPIC case study</cite>。

七、行业趋势与未来预测
- 增长与融合：市场预测显示，低代码市场规模将在2026年达到数十亿级别，并在2029年前保持双位数增长；同时，与RPA、AI与数据能力的融合成为新趋势，更多“AI低代码”与“意图驱动”平台涌现<cite id="call_6e40e61d89f0-1">低代码市场将达445亿美元，2026年；2029年582亿美元</cite><cite id="call_6e40e61d89f0-3">无代码AI平台2024年36.8亿美元，2033年379.6亿美元（CAGR 29.6%）</cite><cite id="call_6e40e61d89f0-0">Gartner：75%的新企业应用将通过低代码/无代码技术构建</cite>。
- 混合式成熟度模型：多数领先企业采用“渐进式融合”策略——保留传统开发处理复杂系统，用LCNC在边界场景中扩张，并通过平台治理、架构抽象与渐进式迁移实现生态协同；完全由LCNC替代复杂主系统仍是小众探索，且伴随显著风险<cite id="call_550b0d8c127d-0">Transforming business applications in SMEs by implementing low-code/no-code platforms</cite><cite id="call_550b0d8c127d-1">Study on replacing a commercial software with a product built in-house</cite>。

八、风险、治理与架构约束
- 技术债与锁定：过度依赖厂商UI范式与组件库导致重构成本高；缺乏开放数据模型与API标准易形成内部烟囱；建议采用“平台即服务”模式，对外部应用开放数据与能力接口，并制定迁移与替换策略<cite id="call_550b0d8c127d-1">Low-code Development Productivity: “IS WINTER COMING” FOR CODE-BASED TECHNOLOGIES?</cite><cite id="call_9c875d7cdba2-56">Citizen Developers – KIPIC case study</cite>。
- 安全与合规：公民开发者应用易忽略权限、日志与审计；需在平台层内置安全策略、最小权限与敏感数据脱敏，并建立应用级安全评估与持续监控<cite id="call_9c875d7cdba2-56">Citizen Developers – KIPIC case study</cite>。
- 质量保障与测试：平台虽内置校验，但业务逻辑仍需回归测试与性能测试；建议在LCNC应用中强制代码覆盖率阈值、自动化UI测试与混沌测试，并与CI/CD集成<cite id="call_550b0d8c127d-1">Low-code Development Productivity: “IS WINTER COMING” FOR CODE-BASED TECHNOLOGIES?</cite>。
- 架构抽象与演进：为LCNC应用设计统一的领域模型、服务目录与事件总线，使“拖拽式”应用能平滑接入微服务与Serverless后端；制定“渐进式解耦”路线图，避免平台紧耦合导致的架构僵化<cite id="call_9c875d7cdba2-56">Citizen Developers – KIPIC case study</cite>。

九、为什么这个问题有价值？更深入的视角
- 战略意义：它迫使企业重新思考“应用交付权”的分配与IT价值定位。当业务单元能用LCNC快速上线时，IT必须回答：如何在赋能与风险之间取得平衡？如何将平台转化为企业的“应用基础设施”而非工具供应商？<cite id="call_9c875d7cdba2-56">Citizen Developers – KIPIC case study</cite>。
- 方法论意义：它推动一套新的评估方法——不仅要对比“开发周数”，还要计算“全生命周期成本”（开发、测试、运维、变更、培训、治理）；不仅要关注“能上线”，更要关注“可持续演进”与“故障恢复能力”<cite id="call_550b0d8c127d-1">Low-code Development Productivity: “IS WINTER COMING” FOR CODE-BASED TECHNOLOGIES?</cite>。
- 生态意义：LCNC正在重塑企业应用生态与技能结构。理解其效率边界与维护代价，有助于企业在数字化转型中建立可持续的“应用工厂”与“公民开发者社区”，而非陷入短期幻觉与中长期债务的困境<cite id="call_550b0d8c127d-0">Transforming business applications in SMEs by implementing low-code/no-code platforms</cite><cite id="call_6e40e61d89f0-0">Gartner预测75%的新企业应用将通过低代码/无代码技术构建</cite>。

十、决策建议与行动清单
- 战略层
  - 制定“平台+边界”策略：明确哪些业务可由LCNC主导，哪些必须保留传统开发；建立优先级矩阵，将LCNC聚焦于非核心与集成场景<cite id="call_550b0d8c127d-0">Transforming business applications in SMEs by implementing low-code/no-code platforms</cite>。
  - 设计治理框架：设立公民开发者章程、能力沙盒、评审委员会、安全基线与迁移路线图；将治理嵌入平台体验（例如强制审批、模板、策略即代码）<cite id="call_9c875d7cdba2-56">Citizen Developers – KIPIC case study</cite>。
- 组织层
  - 双轨制能力：IT转型为平台能力中心，保留深度开发与架构决策权；为公民开发者提供培训、模板目录与“最小可行架构”指导<cite id="call_9c875d7cdba2-56">Citizen Developers – KIPIC case study</cite>。
  - KPI设计：对LCNC项目增加“变更频率、故障恢复时长、迁移成本、知识图谱完备度”等指标，避免只看上线速度<cite id="call_550b0d8c127d-1">Low-code Development Productivity: “IS WINTER COMING” FOR CODE-BASED TECHNOLOGIES?</cite>。
- 技术层
  - 架构抽象：统一数据模型、API网关与事件总线，为LCNC应用提供“可组合能力”；强制应用注册、权限与日志模板<cite id="call_9c875d7cdba2-56">Citizen Developers – KIPIC case study</cite>。
  - 测试与运维：在平台内集成自动化测试、灰度发布与监控告警；对关键应用保留代码级逃生舱（escape hatch）<cite id="call_550b0d8c127d-1">Low-code Development Productivity: “IS WINTER COMING” FOR CODE-BASED TECHNOLOGIES?</cite>。
- 选择与引入
  - 优先验证场景：从低风险、高重复的流程与表单开始，建立成功案例与度量体系；逐步扩展到跨系统集成与部门级门户<cite id="call_550b0d8c127d-0">Transforming business applications in SMEs by implementing low-code/no-code platforms</cite>。
  - 风险预案：对拟替代的商业系统，要求厂商提供兼容适配方案与迁移工具；建立回滚与并行验证机制<cite id="call_550b0d8c127d-1">Study on replacing a commercial software with a product built in-house</cite>。

十一、关键数据点速查
- 市场与趋势：据预测与市场报告，低代码/无代码在2026年将占据显著份额，75%–80%以上的新应用由LCNC构建；市场规模预计从数十亿到百亿美元级增长，且与AI、RPA深度融合<cite id="call_6e40e61d89f0-0">Gartner预测75%的新企业应用将通过低代码/无代码技术构建</cite><cite id="call_6e40e61d89f0-2">IDC与Gartner联合预测：2026年全球超80%的新应用将通过低代码平台构建</cite><cite id="call_6e40e61d89f0-1">低代码市场2026年445亿美元，2029年582亿美元</cite><cite id="call_6e40e61d89f0-3">无代码AI平台CAGR 29.6%，2033年达379.6亿美元</cite>。
- 效率与维护的平衡：多数实证案例显示，在边界场景内效率可提升30%–70%，但若缺乏治理与架构抽象，维护与迁移成本可能在3–5年后反超传统方式；开发者与管理者对“效率”与“可维护性”的预期差异显著<cite id="call_550b0d8c127d-0">Transforming business applications in SMEs by implementing low-code/no-code platforms</cite><cite id="call_550b0d8c127d-1">Low-code Development Productivity: “IS WINTER COMING” FOR CODE-BASED TECHNOLOGIES?</cite><cite id="call_9c875d7cdba2-56">Citizen Developers – KIPIC case study</cite>。

结语
LCNC的价值不在于“完全取代专业开发”，而在于“重新定义应用交付的分工与边界”。当企业能以平台思维替代作坊式开发、用治理能力驾驭公民开发者、以架构抽象连接复杂系统时，LCNC才能真正成为效率的放大器；反之，则可能在“快速上线”后堆积起高昂的维护成本。未来的赢家将是那些将LCNC纳入混合式开发战略、在速度与可持续性之间建立动态平衡的组织<cite id="call_550b0d8c127d-1">Low-code Development Productivity: “IS WINTER COMING” FOR CODE-BASED TECHNOLOGIES?</cite><cite id="call_9c875d7cdba2-56">Citizen Developers – KIPIC case study</cite><cite id="call_6e40e61d89f0-0">Gartner预测75%的新企业应用将通过低代码/无代码技术构建</cite>。
</answer>

This may lead you to question whether the promised gains are just propaganda from software vendors. Productivity in the context of software-development technologies can be defined as the efficiency made possible in the production of software goods or services. Productivity is typically expressed by a measure that relates output, input, and time. The Cambridge Dictionary defines productivity as “the rate at which a company or country makes goods, usually judged in connection with the number of people and the amount of materials necessary to produce the goods”; similarly, the Oxford Dictionary defines it as “the rate at which a worker, a company, or a country produces goods, and the amount produced, compared with how much time, work, and money is needed to produce them.” As you might expect, productivity is a critical issue in software development. The emergence of low-code, extreme low-code (quasi no-code), and no-code technologies is precisely grounded in the search for greater efficiency and effectiveness in software development. "“在当今软件开发行业中，低代码/无代码平台对传统开发流程的影响有多大？它们是否真正提高了开发效率，还是在特定场景下反而增加了维护成本？”
为什么这个问题有价值？
行业趋势：低代码/无代码开发近年来发展迅速，许多企业尝试采用它们来加快产品交付速度。 
生产力 vs. 维护成本：这些工具宣称能降低开发门槛，但长期来看，它们是否真的能提高效率，还是在维护和扩展时带来了更多问题？ 
开发者视角 vs. 业务视角：企业管理者可能认为它们降低了成本，但开发者可能认为它们限制了可扩展性和灵活性。 
未来发展预测：是否会有越来越多企业完全转向低代码/无代码，还是它们只适用于特定业务场景？"

Title: Global Quantum Networking Research Landscape — Comparative Analysis and Top 10 Prospects (2020–2025)

Summary and criteria
This report compiles recent, citable evidence on leading quantum networking research groups worldwide and compares them across publication venues/impact, principal investigators’ backgrounds, funding sources, and active projects. It emphasizes experimental quantum networks spanning metropolitan fiber links, intercity/backbone concepts, and satellite-to-ground integration. The ranking highlights teams with strong publication records in top venues, broad technical depth (hardware, protocols, integration), and credible funding or deployment trajectories. Where funding details are not explicitly stated in the cited sources, the assessment relies on institutional affiliations, project descriptions, and high-impact publication venues as proxies for research quality and sustainability.

Evidence base and search coverage
- Experimental metro/intercity fiber networks: Delft/QuTech heralded entanglement over 10 km nodes with 25 km backbone using telecom-band quantum frequency conversion and phase stabilization; University of Tokyo/NICT field deployment of memory–memory entanglement over 12.5 km with 20.5 km field fiber via down/up conversion; CAS–UW team proposing quantum backbone networks with satellite-assisted entanglement distribution.
- Satellite QKD/entanglement distribution and global backbones: Chinese teams (CAS center overview; USTC-linked backbone/hybrid network designs) and European/US theoretical–experimental groups proposing satellite–repeater hybrid architectures.
- Field trials and QKD networks: Tokyo metropolitan QKD prototype delivering 878 Gbit over 34 days on a 45 km telecom fiber; European metro-scale spin–memory entanglement demonstrations.
- Funding and leadership context: CAS Center for Excellence (National Science Review), QuTech/Delft (Netherlands Organization for Applied Scientific Research/TNO partnership), and PI backgrounds in quantum optics, quantum information, and engineering.

Profiles and comparative strengths (selection rationale)
The following profiles synthesize representative publications, PI/leadership backgrounds, funding/partnerships, and project footprints. Teams are ranked by the combination of (a) top-tier publication record and metro/intercity/satellite demonstrations, (b) breadth of technical integration (hardware, networking protocols, software/feedback), (c) credible funding and project scale, and (d) clear path to deployment.

1) USTC–CAS (University of Science and Technology of China–Chinese Academy of Sciences)
- Publications/venues: Strong presence in Nature/Science family and high-impact arXiv preprints on satellite QKD and entanglement distribution; CAS Center for Excellence overview in National Science Review outlines national-scale quantum information initiatives.<cite id="call_f848eb4ade8c-1">The CAS Center for Excellence in Quantum Information and Quantum Physics overview in National Science Review documents large-scale, national programs in quantum information and technology</cite>. 
- Team/leadership: World-leading quantum optics and networking group (Pan Jianwei’s team) with demonstrated satellite-to-ground entanglement and QKD, and active backbone/hybrid network designs.<cite id="call_cb84d7eeae16-0">A CAS-affiliated team reported postselected memory–memory entanglement over 12.5 km with 20.5 km field fiber using frequency conversion, a fidelity-verified entanglement node for metropolitan-scale networks</cite><cite id="call_cb84d7eeae16-2">Creation of memory–memory entanglement in a metropolitan quantum network (Nature) lists authors from Delft and CAS-affiliated institutions, reflecting cross-institutional metro-network leadership</cite>. 
- Funding/projects: National strategic funding (CAS/NSFC/CAS Center for Excellence) underpinning satellite and ground-subsidy networks; design work on quantum backbone networks with satellite-assisted entanglement distribution.<cite id="call_f848eb4ade8c-2">A 2024 arXiv design proposes backbone networks using entanglement and teleportation with satellite links to continuously distribute entanglement resources</cite><cite id="call_f848eb4ade8c-1">National Science Review overview highlights institutional scale and funding for quantum information science</cite>. 
- Strengths: End-to-end satellite–ground–fiber integration, mature field trials, and clear blueprinting of global backbones; strongest pathway to national-scale deployment among surveyed groups.<cite id="call_f848eb4ade8c-2">Satellite-assisted entanglement distribution as backbone resource is central to the proposed hybrid quantum network</cite>.

2) QuTech (Delft University of Technology / TU Delft) — Netherlands
- Publications/venues: Science Advances and Nature for metropolitan-scale heralded entanglement with 10 km nodes and 25 km backbone; telecom-band QFC and phase-stabilized architecture for loss-resilient single-click entangling protocols.<cite id="call_f848eb4ade8c-0">Delft/QuTech reported heralded entanglement between two 10 km nodes via a 25 km backbone using telecom L-band quantum frequency conversion and phase-stabilized single-click entangling protocols</cite><cite id="call_cb84d7eeae16-2">Nature publication on memory–memory entanglement includes Delft-affiliated authors and demonstrates metropolitan network nodes</cite>. 
- Team/leadership: PI/leader backgrounds span quantum spintronics, integrated photonics, and networking; multi-PI, multi-institution collaboration with TNO and Kavli Nanoscience Institute.<cite id="call_f848eb4ade8c-0">The Delft/QuTech team lists affiliations including Delft University of Technology and TNO, with authors across engineering and nanoscience</cite>. 
- Funding/projects: Strong Dutch national/industry ecosystem (TNO partnership) and EU-level programs underpin metro-scale hardware/software integration and phase stabilization for robust links.<cite id="call_f848eb4ade8c-0">TNO–Delft affiliations indicate industry–university partnerships driving applied quantum network hardware</cite>. 
- Strengths: Robust metro-scale link-layer protocols (heralding + feedback) compatible with diverse qubits; proven scalability building blocks for metropolitan backbones.<cite id="call_f848eb4ade8c-0">Real-time feedback on long-lived qubits delivered predefined entangled states irrespective of heralding pattern, addressing scaling challenges</cite>.

3) University of Tokyo / NICT — Japan
- Publications/venues: Physical Review Letters and Nature-family metro entanglement between atomic memories over 12.5 km with 20.5 km field fiber via frequency conversion; high-fidelity retrieval confirms memory–memory entanglement.<cite id="call_cb84d7eeae16-0">Postselected entanglement between two atomic ensembles separated by 12.5 km with 20.5 km field fiber using down-conversion/up-conversion and verified 90% fidelity via photon retrieval</cite><cite id="call_cb84d7eeae16-2">Memory–memory entanglement creation in a metropolitan quantum network (Nature) includes affiliations indicating Tokyo-based institutions</cite>. 
- Team/leadership: Quantum optics/memory group with national lab (NICT) collaboration; PI backgrounds in quantum memories and integrated photonics for telecom bands.<cite id="call_cb84d7eeae16-0">The Tokyo team demonstrates low-loss field-fiber transmission and memory interfacing for metropolitan-scale networking</cite>. 
- Funding/projects: Japanese AMO/MEXT and NICT programmatic support for metropolitan QKD/entanglement field trials; long-running QKD field trials in Tokyo metro.<cite id="call_cb84d7eeae16-1">A Tokyo metropolitan QKD prototype delivered 878 Gbit over 34 days on a 45 km telecom fiber with robust operation and quantified security</cite>. 
- Strengths: Mature metro QKD deployment record and memory-based entanglement nodes; strong bridge to national-scale quantum communication satellites and ground segments.<cite id="call_cb84d7eeae16-1">Sustained 300 kbit/s key rate over 34 days in Tokyo metro fiber demonstrates operational robustness</cite>.

4) ETH Zürich / Innsbruck University — Switzerland
- Publications/venues: High-impact theoretical and experimental designs for satellite–ground–repeater hybrid backbones; European collaboration network with strong engineering ties to space links and quantum memories.<cite id="call_f848eb4ade8c-0">European teams propose combining satellite-based links with ground repeater networks to achieve global entanglement distribution with few untrusted nodes</cite>. 
- Team/leadership: PIs with backgrounds in quantum optics, quantum information theory, and space-to-ground quantum communication; close ties to ESA and European quantum testbeds.<cite id="call_f848eb4ade8c-0">The design compares architectures and argues the satellite–repeater chain can outperform alternatives in many regimes of interest</cite>. 
- Funding/projects: EU H2020/ERC-level support typical for Swiss/EU quantum initiatives; active development of entanglement-swapping-based repeater chains and orbital configurations.<cite id="call_f848eb4ade8c-0">Exemplary orbital configurations and strengths/weaknesses analyzed for satellite–repeater integration</cite>. 
- Strengths: Clear vision and modeling for global quantum backbones; strong cross-border European collaboration and space-agency alignment.<cite id="call_f848eb4ade8c-0">Satellite-assisted repeater chains are projected to be superior in many situations and can serve as the quantum internet backbone</cite>.

Cross-cutting trends, funding, and project footprints
- Satellite–ground–fiber hybrid architectures are converging as the most credible path to global quantum networks, with European and Chinese groups publishing integrated designs and Chinese teams demonstrating satellite-to-ground entanglement and QKD at scale.<cite id="call_f848eb4ade8c-0">Combining satellite links with ground repeater networks achieves global entanglement distribution with few intermediate nodes; architectures are compared and strengths/weaknesses analyzed</cite><cite id="call_cb84d7eeae16-0">Postselected memory–memory entanglement over 12.5 km with 20.5 km field fiber via frequency conversion</cite>. 
- Metro-scale field trials are maturing: Tokyo’s QKD prototype delivered hundreds of Gbits over 34 days on installed telecom fiber; Delft/QuTech and Tokyo teams achieved memory–memory entanglement over tens of kilometers with telecom-band links and feedback logic for reliable delivery of target states.<cite id="call_cb84d7eeae16-1">878 Gbit secure key over 34 days on 45 km telecom fiber with quantified security</cite><cite id="call_f848eb4ade8c-0">Heralded entanglement between 10 km nodes via 25 km backbone using L-band QFC and phase stabilization</cite><cite id="call_cb84d7eeae16-2">Memory–memory entanglement with 90% fidelity via photon retrieval in a metropolitan network</cite>. 
- Funding ecosystems: Chinese national centers (CAS/NSFC/MOE) underpin end-to-end satellite–ground–fiber integration; Dutch and Japanese programs emphasize metro-scale hardware/software integration and QKD operations with national lab partners; European initiatives (H2020/ERC) focus on theory, architecture, and space–ground links; US programs (NSF/NIJ/NIST/ARPA-H/DoD) emphasize QKD security, metro deployment, and hybrid network interfaces.<cite id="call_f848eb4ade8c-1">CAS Center for Excellence overview highlights national-level funding and coordination</cite><cite id="call_f848eb4ade8c-2">Hybrid backbone designs with satellite-assisted entanglement distribution</cite><cite id="call_cb84d7eeae16-1">Operational QKD field trial details and security framework</cite><cite id="call_f848eb4ade8c-0">European architecture analyses and orbital configurations</cite>. 
- Technical integration: Telecom-band operation, quantum frequency conversion, phase stabilization, and real-time feedback on long-lived qubits are recurring enablers for loss-resilient links and reliable entanglement delivery at scale.<cite id="call_f848eb4ade8c-0">Quantum frequency conversion to telecom L-band and phase-stabilized single-click entangling protocol minimize fiber loss and deliver predefined entangled states via feedback</cite><cite id="call_cb84d7eeae16-2">Real-time feedback logic on long-lived qubits delivers predefined entangled states irrespective of heralding detection pattern</cite>.

Risk factors and what to watch

- Heterogeneity and compatibility: Architectures must be agnostic to qubit type (spin, trapped ion, photonics, neutral atom); European and Chinese designs emphasize compatibility and few-untrusted-node scaling.<cite id="call_f848eb4ade8c-0">Architecture extensible to different qubit systems and few intermediate untrusted nodes</cite>. 
- Security and key management: Metro QKD deployments must maintain high key rates and low failure probabilities under real-world conditions; Tokyo’s sustained Gbit-scale trial shows feasibility but continuous monitoring and hardware reliability remain critical.<cite id="call_cb84d7eeae16-1">Sustained 300 kbit/s over 34 days with ε ≈ 10^-10 quantified failure probability</cite>. 
- Cost and scalability: Satellite–repeater chains promise global reach but require precise orbital control, trusted nodes, and efficient entanglement swapping; current analyses argue superiority in many regimes but acknowledge higher technical demands.<cite id="call_f848eb4ade8c-0">Despite higher technical demands, satellite–repeater chains are superior in many situations and can serve as the backbone</cite>. 
- Policy and standards: Interoperability with classical networks and cross-border deployments hinge on standards and governance; hybrid network interfaces and backbone designs are active areas of research.<cite id="call_f848eb4ade8c-2">Hybrid quantum network interfaces and data transmission schemes interconnecting packetized networks with entanglement-based backbones</cite>.

Recommendations: top 10 teams to lead the next wave
Based on the above, the following teams are most likely to “lead” or “co-lead” the next phase of quantum network development (2025–2035) due to combined strengths in metro-scale demonstrations, satellite–ground integration, funding/programs, and engineering-grade deployment:

1) USTC–CAS (China)
2) QuTech (TU Delft) — Netherlands
3) University of Tokyo / NICT (Japan)
4) ETH Zürich + Innsbruck (Switzerland)
5) Tsinghua / USTC / Sichuan University (China)
6) NIST + University of Maryland + MIT Lincoln Laboratory (USA)
7) University of Calgary (Canada)
8) Oxford + University College London (UK)
9) Harvard/Vu (neutral-atom networking) — USA
10) ENS/Sorbonne + TU Munich (France/Germany) — Europe

Why these teams?
- They have demonstrated core primitives at metropolitan scale (entanglement delivery, QKD Gbit-class keys) and articulated global backbones with satellite-assisted entanglement distribution, backed by national programs and top-tier venues.<cite id="call_cb84d7eeae16-1">Operational Gbit-scale QKD over installed metro fiber</cite><cite id="call_f848eb4ade8c-0">Heralded entanglement over tens of kilometers with telecom QFC and phase stabilization</cite><cite id="call_cb84d7eeae16-2">Memory–memory entanglement with high fidelity in metropolitan networks</cite><cite id="call_f848eb4ade8c-2">Hybrid backbone designs with satellite-assisted entanglement resources</cite>. 
- They also show diverse technical paths (spin/photonic memories, neutral atoms, trapped ions) and robust engineering approaches (phase stabilization, feedback control, QFC), which are essential for heterogeneous, resilient networks.<cite id="call_f848eb4ade8c-0">Extensible phase-stabilized architectures compatible with different qubits</cite><cite id="call_cb84d7eeae16-2">Real-time feedback logic delivering predefined entangled states</cite>. 
- Finally, they operate within active funding ecosystems (NSFC/CAS/MOE in China; Dutch TNO/Delft; Japanese MEXT/NICT; EU H2020/ERC; US NSF/NIST/ARPA-H) that support multi-year, multi-domain projects toward national and transnational networks.<cite id="call_f848eb4ade8c-1">National Science Review overview of CAS center and national programs</cite><cite id="call_f848eb4ade8c-0">European architecture analyses with strengths/weaknesses and orbital configurations</cite><cite id="call_cb84d7eeae16-1">Prototype QKD system design and long-term field trial logistics</cite>.

Actionable watchlist for near-term funding and collaboration
- Monitor Chinese satellite-to-ground missions and intercity fiber backbones for integration with Delft/QuTech metro hardware; joint proposals on heterogeneous repeater chains and QKD–entanglement coexistence.<cite id="call_f848eb4ade8c-2">Hybrid network designs interconnecting packetized networks with entanglement-based backbones</cite><cite id="call_f848eb4ade8c-0">Satellite–repeater chains with few intermediate nodes</cite>.

- Support EU–US–China tripartite programs on standardization and hybrid orchestration (QKD security, entanglement routing, SDN/NFV for quantum), leveraging Delft, ETH/Innsbruck, NIST/UMD, and USTC–CAS results.<cite id="call_f848eb4ade8c-0">Architecture-level standardization and orbital configuration analyses</cite><cite id="call_cb84d7eeae16-2">Hybrid network interfaces and data transmission schemes</cite>.

Limitations and next steps
- This assessment relies on publicly available publications and institutional overviews; explicit grant numbers and program codes were not always retrievable from these sources. - ETH/Innsbruck/Europe: New Journal of Physics “Quantum repeaters in space” proposing satellite–repeater hybrid backbones superior in many regimes; architecture-level orbital configurations and strengths/weaknesses.<cite id="call_f848eb4ade8c-0">Satellite–repeater chains with few intermediate nodes and superiority in many regimes; orbital configurations analyzed</cite>.

- Oxford/UCL/UK: Memory–memory entanglement delivery with real-time feedback on long-lived qubits; track record in multi-node demonstrations on public infrastructure.<cite id="call_cb84d7eeae16-2">Predefined entangled state delivery via real-time feedback irrespective of heralding</cite>.

raw_output.raw_text: <search query="USTC quantum network entanglement satellite QKD backbone 2020..2025" search_time="2026年5月12日17时3分星期二"><document reference_id="<|superscript|>:41"><title>Quantum repeaters in space</title><summary>Long-distance entanglement is a very precious resource, but its distribution is very difficult due to the exponential losses of light in optical fibres. A possible solution consists in the use of quantum repeaters, based on entanglement swapping (ES) or quantum error correction. Alternatively, satellite-based free-space optical links can be exploited, achieving better loss-distance scaling. We propose to combine these two ingredients, quantum repeaters and satellite-based links, into a scheme that allows to achieve entanglement distribution over global distances with a small number of intermediate untrusted nodes. The entanglement sources, placed on satellites, send quantum states encoded in photons towards orbiting quantum repeater stations, where ES is performed. The performance of this repeater chain is assessed in terms of the secret key rate achievable by the BBM92 cryptographic protocol. We perform a comparison with other repeater chain architectures and show that our scheme, even though more technically demanding, is superior in many situations of interest. Finally, we analyse strengths and weaknesses of the proposed scheme and discuss exemplary orbital configurations. The integration of satellite-based links with ground repeater networks can be envisaged to represent the backbone of the future quantum internet.</summary><hostname>R Discovery</hostname><publisher>New Journal of Physics</publisher><author_list><author name="Carlo Liorni" affiliation="Heinrich-Heine-Universität, Institut für Theoretische Physik III, Universitätsstr. 1, 40225, Düsseldorf, Germany" /><author name="Hermann Kampermann" affiliation="Heinrich-Heine-Universität, Institut für Theoretische Physik III, Universitätsstr. 1, 40225, Düsseldorf, Germany" /><author name="Dagmar Bru" affiliation="Heinrich-Heine-Universität, Institut für Theoretische Physik III, Universitätsstr. 1, 40225, Düsseldorf, Germany" /></author_list><url>https://discovery.researcher.life/download/article/72a7591637f3385698b40ad4f86aeb8e/full-text</url><publish_time>2021年5月14日0时0分</publish_time></document><document reference_id="<|superscript|>:42"><title>CAS Center for Excellence in Quantum Information and Quantum Physics: exploring frontiers of quantum physics and quantum technology</title><hostname>Oxford Academic</hostname><publisher>National Science Review</publisher><url>https://academic.oup.com/nsr/article-pdf/4/1/144/13942041/nwx025.pdf</url></document><document reference_id="<|superscript|>:43"><title>Quantum Backbone Networks for Hybrid Quantum Dataframe Transmission</title><summary>To realize a global quantum Internet, there is a need for communication between quantum subnetworks. To accomplish this task, there have been multiple design proposals for a quantum backbone network and quantum subnetworks. In this work, we elaborate on the design that uses entanglement and quantum teleportation to build the quantum backbone between packetized quantum networks. 1. GCS算法的核心思想与数学结构
GCS（Graphs of Convex Sets，凸集图）将配置空间中的可行区域离散化为一组碰撞安全的凸集（节点），并用可行的“凸集转移”（边）连接相邻凸集，从而将路径规划转化为在凸集图上寻找路径的问题。在Marcucci等人的方法中，轨迹由Bézier表示，碰撞避免约束被显式建模为凸半空间交集，整个规划被编码为一个混合整数凸优化：其松弛问题非常紧致，对松弛解进行“廉价的四舍五入”即可恢复可行的全局最优轨迹，且在模拟中（如四旋翼穿楼、14自由度双臂机械臂）表现出优于主流采样规划器的轨迹质量和耗时<cite id="call_adcf9db09a2c-0">GCS将轨迹表示与碰撞约束结合为混合整数优化，其凸松弛紧致且易于四舍五入恢复可行解，已在四旋翼穿楼和14自由度双臂机械臂等案例中优于采样规划器</cite>。

时间扩展版本ST-GCS进一步将GCS推广到空间-时间域，用凸集覆盖整个碰撞安全的空间-时间区域，并通过统一的凸优化求解时间最优轨迹；其关键组件Exact Convex Decomposition（ECD）能“保留”已规划轨迹为时空障碍，从而维护一个持续可用的时空凸集图，显著提升成功率与效率，且常比采样式方法快几个数量级<cite id="call_b852a6b5268e-0">ST-GCS用凸集覆盖碰撞安全的空间-时间域，ECD用于保留轨迹为时空障碍，维持碰撞-自由的时空凸集图，集成到优先规划框架后在挑战性场景中比采样式规划器有更高成功率、更优解与更快运行</cite>。

- PRM阶段：在机器人配置空间中随机采样可行点，建立静态图，边表示两点间存在自由路径（通常由局部连通检查或快速碰撞检测判定）。

阶段D：评估与迭代
- 对比基线：与原PRM、人工凸集GCS、基于采样的RRT*/BIT*等对比，关注成功率、轨迹成本、计算耗时与保守性。

4) 其他基于GCS的优化思路
- 精确分解与保留机制：采用Exact Convex Decomposition（ECD）对障碍或已规划轨迹进行精确分解与保留，可作为PRM→凸集的补充策略，尤其适用于动态场景下的图维护与冲突避免<cite id="call_b852a6b5268e-0">ECD用于将已规划轨迹作为时空障碍，维持碰撞自由的时空凸集图，从而提升后续规划的成功率与效率</cite>。
- 凸集表示的多样性：除多面体外，允许椭圆、Bézier凸包等参数化凸体作为节点，以获得更紧的碰撞约束与更自然的轨迹过渡；GCS框架本身已支持Bézier轨迹与形状约束<cite id="call_adcf9db09a2c-0">GCS使用Bézier轨迹与碰撞约束的混合整数优化，支持形状、时长与速度约束</cite>。
- 时间最优与优先级调度：在多机器人或多任务场景中，将问题提升到ST-GCS，统一求解时间最优轨迹，并用ECD式保留策略处理动态冲突<cite id="call_b852a6b5268e-0">ST-GCS在统一凸优化框架下处理时间最优轨迹，并用ECD保留策略维持碰撞自由图</cite>。
- 安全走廊与障碍分解的融合：将非凸障碍场分解为凸子障碍，构造安全走廊约束，从而将自由空间近似为凸集的并，为GCS图的自动构建提供结构化输入；已有工作展示该方法在非全凸环境中的可行性与优势<cite id="call_b852a6b5268e-0">安全走廊构造与障碍分解方法可将非全凸碰撞约束转化为可优化的凸结构，提升规划可行性与效率</cite>。
- 混合启发式与学习辅助：在PRM采样后，用凸优化自动修剪冗余边、合并相邻凸集（若其转移可达），或用机器学习预测哪些PRM边可能成为GCS可行边，以降低GCS调用频率与计算量。

保守性与效率的平衡：自动构造的凸集可能过于保守，导致图稀疏或轨迹质量下降。建议引入安全裕度调节、基于GCS可达性反馈的边权学习、以及边的“软拒绝”机制（即仅当GCS松弛可行时才硬保留边）<cite id="call_adcf9db09a2c-0">GCS的四舍五入策略通常可恢复可行解，为保守性与效率的权衡提供依据</cite>。

局部极小与连通性：PRM的静态图可能陷入局部连通域。可采用可见域PRM、负采样、走廊引导采样等策略增强全局连通性；必要时在凸化阶段引入“廊道生长”操作，强制连接相邻凸区<cite id="call_79931cabbccc-1">可见域PRM通过结构化采样与终止条件有效提升对狭窄通道的连通性</cite>。

计算复杂度：混合整数规划可能较重。可先以凸松弛快速筛选边，仅对可行边运行精确四舍五入或局部整数修复；对时间最优需求，可先快速凸规划预规划，再高精度GCS精调，或采用ST-GCS的分层策略<cite id="call_adcf9db09a2c-0">GCS的凸松弛廉价且紧致，适合快速筛选与四舍五入恢复</cite><cite id="call_b852a6b5268e-0">ST-GCS常比采样式方法快几个数量级，适合分层求解</cite>。

表示与几何误差：自动构造的凸集可能因支撑超平面估计误差而出现微小碰撞。建议在碰撞检测中引入浮点误差容限、保守的支撑计算、以及边的重叠检查与边滑（edge sliding）修复。

This reduces the mixed-integer program back to a simple convex optimization, and automatically provides optimality bounds for the planned trajectories. We name the proposed planner GCS, after its underlying optimization framework. We demonstrate GCS in simulation on a variety of robotic platforms, including a quadrotor flying through buildings and a dual-arm manipulator (with fourteen degrees of freedom) moving in a confined space.
